note: Current defects only: this index lists what exists at `target`. Fixed defects are never listed. Generated by scripts/known_issues.py from the verified findings; do not edit by hand.

bug.label: Bug
bug.definition: Existing behaviour violates an intended or documented contract.

functional-gap.label: Functional gap
functional-gap.definition: Functionality is intentionally or currently incomplete or unsupported; nothing violates a contract, the contract is narrower than one might expect.

platform-limitation.label: Platform limitation
platform-limitation.definition: A host, platform or toolchain constraint makes behaviour differ or be unavailable.

verification-gap.label: Verification gap
verification-gap.definition: An implementation exists, but the evidence that it behaves correctly is insufficient.

issues.title: SpriteEffect caches a MatrixTransform parameter that never exists, so OnApply() never sets the sprite projection
issues.summary: SpriteEffect looks up a MatrixTransform parameter its base Effect never creates, so Parameters["MatrixTransform"] is null and OnApply() returns before computing the orthographic projection and half-pixel offset.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::SpriteEffect: its MatrixTransform parameter and OnApply()

issues.title: Load<Song> and Load<Video> resolve a same-named .cnj file and return a media object that points at JSON
issues.summary: ResolveAssetPath tries name.cnj before the Song and Video readers' media extensions, and neither reader handles .cnj, so a same-named .cnj silently becomes the Song or Video file.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load for Media::Song and Media::Video (the loose-file tier)

issues.title: GraphicsDeviceCapabilityTest's catch-all expectations are still wrong for STUB and for Linux SDL_GPU builds without libshaderc
issues.summary: ExpectedCapabilities() now has an SDL_GPU arm, but on Linux it keeps the catch-all custom-effects expectation true although an SDL_GPU build without libshaderc answers false, and STUB, which answers false to every capability, still takes the all-true default.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDeviceCapabilityTest.SupportsOcclusionQuery, SupportsCustomEffects and SupportsMultipleRenderTargets (ExpectedCapabilities())

issues.title: The .cnj JSON parser (CNA::Internal::ParseJson) recurses without a nesting limit, so a small crafted document overflows the stack
issues.summary: JsonParser recurses once per nesting level with no ceiling; a document of 100,000 nested arrays (200,000 bytes) crashed a probe with SIGSEGV instead of throwing JsonParseException, and with the default 8 MiB stack at -O0 about 13,400 levels (27 KB) are already enough.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Internal::ParseJson - documented to throw JsonParseException for malformed input; reached by every .cnj load, the .cnj compilers and the gamer-services offline achievement catalog

issues.title: XnbReadLimits::maxFileSize is not applied to ContentManager's whole-file .xnb reads
issues.summary: The 64 MiB maxFileSize ceiling is enforced by the decompressors and the build-time canonical read, but ContentManager reads a run-time .xnb of up to INT32_MAX bytes and the manifest scan reads any size.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Internal::Xnb::XnbReadLimits::maxFileSize ("Largest .xnb file this reader will attempt to open, in bytes") as applied by ContentManager::Load

issues.title: ReflectiveTypeReader has no TypeVersion, so an XNA .xnb for a [ContentSerializerTypeVersion] type is rejected
issues.summary: Reader versions must match exactly, as in XNA, but a reflective reader always reports version 0 and ReflectiveTypeReaderBuilder cannot declare the version XNA's ReflectiveReader takes from the attribute.
issues.public_contract: ReflectiveTypeReader and ReflectiveTypeReaderBuilder (ContentTypeReaderBase::getTypeVersionProperty / SupportsVersion); XNA 4.0 ReflectiveReader.TypeVersion

issues.title: PlaneIntersectionType's Doxygen swaps the meaning of Front and Back
issues.summary: PlaneIntersectionType.hpp documents Front as the negative half-space and Back as the positive one, the opposite of what every CNA classification returns and of XNA's meaning.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::PlaneIntersectionType (Front, Back) as documented in its public header

issues.title: Curve::ComputeTangent Smooth tangents test the key spacing against two different epsilons, where XNA tests the value difference against one
issues.summary: For CurveTangent::Smooth, ComputeTangent zeroes the in tangent when the neighbour span is below 2^-24 but the out tangent only below the smallest denormal, while XNA zeroes both when the neighbours' value difference is below FLT_EPSILON.
issues.public_contract: Curve::ComputeTangent(int, CurveTangent, CurveTangent), ComputeTangents (all overloads) with CurveTangent::Smooth; the C ABI cna_curve_compute_tangent* routes

issues.title: A copied Texture2D or TextureCube raises GraphicsDevice.ResourceDestroyed without a matching ResourceCreated, and a copy taken after its device died still reaches the device on disposal
issues.summary: Texture copies are now registered with their device, but a copy never raises ResourceCreated while its disposal raises ResourceDestroyed, and a copy taken after the device was destroyed still touches the dead device's texture slots on disposal.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice.ResourceCreated / GraphicsDevice.ResourceDestroyed; Texture2D(const Texture2D&), TextureCube(const TextureCube&); GraphicsResource copy constructor; Texture::Dispose(bool)

issues.title: devices-tests.yml's exact-name gtest filters skip nine Microsoft::Devices suites and never match the FileDialog and MessageBox suites
issues.summary: DEVICES_GTEST_FILTER misses 34 of 479 TEST definitions under modules/devices/tests, and CNA_DEVICES_GTEST_FILTER names FileDialogTests.* and MessageBoxTests.*, which match no suite, so the 12 FileDialog and MessageBox cases run in no CI job.
issues.public_contract: .github/workflows/devices-tests.yml: DEVICES_GTEST_FILTER (documented as every TEST(...) under modules/devices/tests/Microsoft/Devices/, no more and no fewer) and CNA_DEVICES_GTEST_FILTER (the modules/devices-ext/tests/CNA/Devices/ scope)

issues.title: run-all-renderer-smoke-tests.sh ignores the build's exit status, and its '-- -k' build flag aborts every Ninja build, so smoke verdicts can come from stale binaries
issues.summary: The orchestrator runs cmake --build <dir> -j4 -- -k and discards the result; -k without a count is a make option that Ninja rejects, so in a Ninja tree nothing is rebuilt and ctest runs whatever executables the tree already holds.
issues.public_contract: scripts/run-all-renderer-smoke-tests.sh (default, --tier and --multi modes): a renderer that configures and builds but fails its smoke test fails the run

issues.title: A relative ContentManager root still follows the working directory on the non-SDL3 platforms, and the loose tier cannot see Android packaged assets
issues.summary: ContentManager now roots a relative RootDirectory under TitleLocation and reads .cnb through the platform on Android, but TitleLocation is the working directory on the non-SDL3 platforms and the loose tier still gates on std::filesystem::exists.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::RootDirectory and ContentManager::Load path resolution (XNA resolves through TitleContainer.OpenStream, relative to the title location)

issues.title: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md still omits the vendored ENet and dr_libs
issues.summary: Draco, stb_vorbis, stb_image and cgltf now have notices, but ENet and dr_flac/dr_mp3, both vendored under third_party/ and compiled into CNA libraries, are not listed.
issues.public_contract: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md as CNA's record of third-party licences for code it compiles in

issues.title: StorageContainer::GetFileNames/GetDirectoryNames(searchPattern): GlobMatch treats ? as one byte and compares case-sensitively on every host
issues.summary: The hand-written matcher behind the pattern overloads matches ? against one UTF-8 byte rather than one character and compares bytes case-sensitively even on Windows, where XNA's Directory.GetFiles matching is not; only star patterns over ASCII names are exercised by any test, and only through the C ABI smoke test.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Storage::StorageContainer::GetFileNames(const std::string& searchPattern) and GetDirectoryNames(const std::string& searchPattern); the C name-count and name-copy routes that take a search_pattern

issues.title: Guide message-box and keyboard-input results expose an AsyncWaitHandle that is already signalled while the answer is pending
issues.summary: Guide's message-box and keyboard-input results construct their AsyncWaitHandle already signalled, so WaitOne returns while IsCompleted is still false; End* now waits by running the game's modal frames and refuses only when no running game shows the Guide.
issues.public_contract: getAsyncWaitHandleProperty() and getIsCompletedProperty() of the IAsyncResult returned by Guide::BeginShowMessageBox and Guide::BeginShowKeyboardInput; EndShowMessageBox and EndShowKeyboardInput

issues.title: SongTypeReader and MediaLibraryIndex offer song formats (.opus, .aac, .wma) that no CNA-configured mixer decodes
issues.summary: Load<Song> resolves .opus, .aac and .wma files and the media library indexes .opus, but neither the vendored SDL3_mixer build nor CNA's ALSA mixer decodes them, so such songs load and then silently fail to play.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Media::Song> (loose-file tier, SongTypeReader::GetExtensions) and MediaLibrary::getSongsProperty (MediaLibraryIndex scan)

issues.title: HEADLESS reports occlusion-query support and a precise pixel count while its query always answers 1
issues.summary: HEADLESS inherits OcclusionQuery = true and the default isPixelCountPreciseEXT() = true, but HeadlessOcclusionQueryRenderer completes at once and returns PixelCount() == 1 whatever was drawn.
issues.public_contract: CNA::GraphicsCapability::OcclusionQuery and OcclusionQuery::isPixelCountPreciseEXT() on the HEADLESS renderer

issues.title: CHANGELOG.md's v0.1.0-alpha.1 section says 49 renderer identities for a release that had 50
issues.summary: The C API documents, core_ext.h and ModuleProbes.cmake no longer state obsolete whole-registry renderer counts, but the alpha.1 release notes still say 49 renderer identities where that tag's selection list holds 50; no count gate reads the changelog.
issues.public_contract: The CHANGELOG.md release notes of v0.1.0-alpha.1

issues.title: docs/c-api/README.md still presents the C ABI as its initial 0.1.0 library while abi.h declares 0.50.0
issues.summary: The release gate reads its ABI label from abi.h and the old feature matrix is gone, but the C API README opens by calling the library its initial 0.1.0 shared library and then lists today's surface.
issues.public_contract: cna_get_abi_version and the ABI identity declared in CNA/C/abi.h (CNA_ABI_VERSION_MAJOR / MINOR / PATCH), as documented under docs/c-api

issues.title: RegisterAllBuiltInXnbReaders() documentation still calls the general EffectReader a known-unsupported placeholder
issues.summary: XnbBuiltInReaders.hpp says the function registers "the known-unsupported placeholder (the general EffectReader, XNB-32A)", but it registers the implemented EffectReader and the placeholder hook registers nothing.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Internal::Xnb::RegisterAllBuiltInXnbReaders() (doc comment in XnbBuiltInReaders.hpp)

issues.title: LIMITATIONS.md omits the 633 planned public C++ declarations and RELEASE_GATE.md still attributes 654 declarations to CBIND-117
issues.summary: The generated C API limitations document partitions 7,501 of the 8,134 declarations it counts and never mentions the 633 planned ones, and the release-gate note still says the Content Pipeline task owns 654 declarations where the plan records 134.
issues.public_contract: docs/c-api/LIMITATIONS.md (generated by tools/c-api/generate_limitations.py) and docs/c-api/RELEASE_GATE.md (generated from tools/c-api/release_gate.json)

issues.title: Curve::Evaluate divides by a zero key span in the cyclic loop modes and converts the resulting infinity to int
issues.summary: When every key shares one position, GetNumberOfCycle divides by the zero key span without a guard and casts the infinity to int (undefined behaviour) in the Cycle, CycleOffset and Oscillate loop modes, where XNA's cycle count is 0.
issues.public_contract: Curve::Evaluate(float) for curves whose keys all share one position, with a Cycle, CycleOffset or Oscillate pre- or post-loop; C ABI cna_curve_evaluate

issues.title: Vector2/3/4 and Matrix division by a scalar divide every component where XNA 4.0 multiplies by one reciprocal
issues.summary: Divide(v, s), operator/(v, s) and Matrix::Divide(m, s) divide per component where XNA multiplies by 1/s, so results can differ in the last bit; Vector3::operator/= alone uses the reciprocal.
issues.public_contract: Vector2/Vector3/Vector4::Divide(value, float), operator/(value, float), operator/=(float); Matrix::Divide(const Matrix&, float, Matrix&)

issues.title: Ray::Intersects(BoundingSphere) returns no hit for a ray that starts exactly on the sphere and points outward
issues.summary: The sphere overload returns 0 only when the origin is strictly inside, so a ray starting on the surface and pointing outward gets no hit, where XNA's inside test is <= and returns 0. The box overload now matches XNA.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Ray::Intersects(BoundingSphere) (and the out-parameter overload)

issues.title: BoundingFrustum::Intersects(Plane) counts a corner lying on the plane as Intersecting, where XNA 4.0 answers Back
issues.summary: The Plane overload treats a corner at zero distance as Intersecting, so a frustum touching a plane from behind is Intersecting where XNA (distance > 0 is Front, everything else Back) answers Back. The box and sphere overloads now match XNA.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::BoundingFrustum::Intersects(Plane) and its out-parameter overload

issues.title: Math ToString methods print floats with six significant digits and the C++ global locale, where XNA 4.0 uses Single.ToString(CurrentCulture)
issues.summary: The math ToString methods stream floats through a default std::ostringstream (6 digits, global locale), while .NET's Single.ToString prints up to 7 significant digits in the current culture.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Vector2/Vector3/Vector4/Quaternion/Matrix/Plane::ToString()

issues.title: Point declares +, -, * and / operators that XNA 4.0's Point does not have, without the CNAEXT marker, and / has no divide-by-zero guard
issues.summary: CNA_STRICT_XNA_API cannot flag these extensions because they are not marked CNAEXT, and Point / Point with a zero component is an integer division by zero.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Point operator+, operator-, operator*, operator/

issues.title: Color::FromNonPremultiplied(int r, int g, int b, int a) multiplies in 32-bit int, so large arguments overflow (undefined behaviour)
issues.summary: CNA computes r * a / 255 in int; XNA 4.0 widens to 64-bit long before multiplying and clamps the result, so arguments whose product exceeds INT_MAX are defined in XNA and undefined in CNA.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Color::FromNonPremultiplied(intcs r, intcs g, intcs b, intcs a)

issues.title: Game::PollEvents fires the renderer's test-only context-loss hooks on F9/F10 in every build
issues.summary: A non-repeated F9 or F10 press in any CNA game calls the renderer's DebugSimulateContextLoss() or DebugRestoreContext(), a channel CNA itself describes as a test seam, with no build, option or opt-out guard.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Game::Run() / Tick() (through the private PollEvents); CNA::Internal::Renderers::IGraphicsRenderer::DebugSimulateContextLoss() and DebugRestoreContext()

issues.title: The Emscripten Game loop (EmscriptenMainLoopCallback) does not implement Game's loop contract
issues.summary: In the browser, Game ignores SuppressDraw and ResetElapsedTime, uses FNA's clock order instead of the XNA rule the desktop loop implements, and turns a frame exception into a normal return from Run() without Exiting.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Game::Run() under Emscripten; IsFixedTimeStep, SuppressDraw(), ResetElapsedTime(), GameTime, the Exiting event

issues.title: Game::InactiveSleepTime is stored and validated but the loop never sleeps while the game is inactive
issues.summary: InactiveSleepTime is documented in Game.hpp and the C API as how long the loop sleeps while the game is inactive, but nothing in Tick, RunLoop or the browser frame reads it, so an unfocused game keeps its full frame rate.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Game::getInactiveSleepTimeProperty() / setInactiveSleepTimeProperty(); cna_game_get_inactive_sleep_time_ticks / cna_game_set_inactive_sleep_time_ticks

issues.title: GraphicsDeviceManager leaves dangling references when its lifetime is not nested inside its Game
issues.summary: Game never clears its cached manager and service pointers, the manager never removes its ClientSizeChanged handler, and ~GraphicsDeviceManager dereferences its Game, so a manager that dies before or after its game is a use-after-free.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::GraphicsDeviceManager(Game*), ~GraphicsDeviceManager(), GraphicsDeviceManager::Dispose(); Game::getGraphicsDeviceProperty(), Game::BeginDraw()/EndDraw(), Game::Dispose()

issues.title: PhoneApplicationService::getCurrentProperty()'s static instance detaches from an already-destroyed Game during static destruction
issues.summary: The process-wide PhoneApplicationService is a function-local static holding a borrowed Game*; attached to a Game that is destroyed first, its destructor calls DetachEXT on the dead game's events.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Phone::Shell::PhoneApplicationService::getCurrentProperty(), AttachEXT(Game&), DetachEXT() and ~PhoneApplicationService()

issues.title: GameTime.IsRunningSlowly follows FNA's lag counter, not XNA 4.0's rule
issues.summary: CNA sets IsRunningSlowly after five accumulated extra steps and clears it when the lag counter returns to zero; XNA 4.0 reports it when two multi-step ticks occur within 20 ticks and assigns it before each Update, so the flag differs tick by tick.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::GameTime::IsRunningSlowly as set by Game::Tick

issues.title: In variable-step mode Game gives its first updates a non-zero ElapsedGameTime where XNA 4.0 reports zero
issues.summary: The zero-first-update rule exists only on the fixed-step path; in variable step the first Update gets the time since Run() began, while XNA values recorded by CNA show zero elapsed for the first two updates.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Game::Tick (variable time step) / GameTime.ElapsedGameTime

issues.title: GraphicsDeviceInformation accepts a null Adapter, and GraphicsDeviceManager then binds a reference through that null pointer
issues.summary: XNA's documentation says the GraphicsDeviceInformation.Adapter setter throws ArgumentNullException for a null value (the shipped IL only tests the stored adapter, so the first null slips through in real XNA). CNA's setter stores any pointer, and applyToExistingRenderer then dereferences its GraphicsDeviceInformation's getAdapterProperty() when it calls GraphicsDevice::Reset, which is undefined behaviour for a null adapter; in practice the device keeps its previous adapter.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::GraphicsDeviceInformation::setAdapterProperty; PreparingDeviceSettings handlers

issues.title: GameWindow keeps a raw pointer to the platform window owned by the Game's GraphicsDevice, and nothing clears it when the game disposes that device
issues.summary: Game's constructor hands GraphicsDevice_.GetPlatformWindowInternal() to Window_.setWindowInternal; GraphicsDevice::Dispose destroys the platform window (destroyNativeResources resets platformWindow_), after which GameWindow members dereference freed memory.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::GameWindow members after an explicit GraphicsDevice::Dispose() on the Game's device

issues.title: Public non-XNA members Texture::GetFormatSizeEXT, GetBlockSizeSquaredEXT, GetPixelStoreAlignment, ValidateGetDataFormat and GameWindow's IsBorderlessEXT accessors carry no CNAEXT marker
issues.summary: Four public static Texture helpers and the GameWindow borderless getter and setter are not XNA 4.0 API but are not tagged CNAEXT, so a CNA_STRICT_XNA_API build compiles calls to them silently.
issues.public_contract: CNAEXT marker rule; Texture::GetBlockSizeSquaredEXT, Texture::GetFormatSizeEXT, Texture::GetPixelStoreAlignment, Texture::ValidateGetDataFormat, GameWindow::getIsBorderlessEXTProperty, GameWindow::setIsBorderlessEXTProperty

issues.title: HeadlessRenderer::GetLastFrameStatistics() reports the frame in progress, not the finished frame its documentation names
issues.summary: GetLastFrameStatistics() is documented as the statistics of the frame ending at the most recent Present(), but it subtracts the snapshot taken at that Present from the running totals, and a test pins that behaviour.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Internal::Renderers::Headless::HeadlessRenderer::GetLastFrameStatistics() (HEADLESS debugging API)

issues.title: A GraphicsDevice constructor that fails after renderer resolution leaves the selection latched to the renderer it destroyed
issues.summary: The GraphicsDevice constructor latches the selection inside resolveRenderer(), then updates the viewport and pushes default states; if one of those throws, the catch block destroys the renderer without unlatching, so SetPreferred is refused.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice construction failure path and CNA::GraphicsRendererSelection::SetPreferred / IsLatched / GetActive

issues.title: GraphicsDevice::Reset rolls back only the window and virtual-resolution stage; a later renderer failure leaves the new PresentationParameters stored and DeviceReset unraised
issues.summary: An exception from UpdatePresentationFormatEXT, ApplyMultiSampleCount or SetSwapInterval escapes after the new parameters are stored and render targets were unbound, and after DeviceResetting was raised, so the device reports settings it may not have applied.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::GraphicsDevice::Reset(const PresentationParameters&, GraphicsAdapter*) and its three shorter overloads

issues.title: DIRECTX9 reports AnisotropicFiltering and MultiSampleAntiAliasing unconditionally and writes MaxAnisotropy to the sampler without clamping to the device cap
issues.summary: DirectX9Renderer inherits the interface's default true capability answers, and its fixed-function/stock ApplySamplerState passes the requested MaxAnisotropy straight to D3DSAMP_MAXANISOTROPY, although its compiled-effect path clamps to D3DCAPS9::MaxAnisotropy.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice::SupportsCapability(AnisotropicFiltering / MultiSampleAntiAliasing) and SamplerState.MaxAnisotropy on DIRECTX9

issues.title: PbrEffect, SkinnedPbrEffect and ColorMatrixEffect clone a disposed source instead of throwing ObjectDisposedException
issues.summary: The XNA stock effects, SpriteEffect, the compiled Effect::Clone() and, since CNA-DEMOS-ISSUE-055, ShaderEffect refuse a disposed source, but the CNA extension effects PbrEffect, SkinnedPbrEffect and ColorMatrixEffect copy-construct through Effect(device) and do not check.
issues.public_contract: Effect::Clone() on CNA PbrEffect, SkinnedPbrEffect and ColorMatrixEffect

issues.title: DIRECTX9 draws a 3D ShaderEffect with the stock BasicEffect shader or fails with a BasicEffect vertex-layout error instead of using or refusing the custom effect
issues.summary: DIRECTX9 compiles ShaderEffect HLSL and runs it for SpriteBatch, but its 3D dispatch never reads GpuDrawParams::customEffectRenderer or customEffectRequested, so a 3D ShaderEffect draw is drawn with the stock vertex-colour BasicEffect shader or refused with a BasicEffect vertex-layout error that does not name the custom effect.
issues.public_contract: ShaderEffect (CNA extension) with GraphicsDevice::DrawPrimitives/DrawIndexedPrimitives on DIRECTX9; GraphicsCapability::CustomEffects; RendererCapabilityProfile

issues.title: Stock-effect state is captured at draw time, so a property changed after EffectPass::Apply() affects the next draw, unlike XNA
issues.summary: GraphicsDevice calls currentEffect_->FillGpuDrawParams() inside every draw, reading the stock effect's current World, colours and so on; XNA commits effect state at Apply() and a later property change only marks the effect dirty for the next Apply.
issues.public_contract: BasicEffect and the other stock effects' properties between EffectPass::Apply() and GraphicsDevice::Draw*Primitives

issues.title: ShaderEffect::SetTexture(int, Texture2D&), SetTexture(int, TextureCube&) and SetTexture(int, Texture3D&) evaluate *renderer_ of a disposed texture (an empty shared_ptr) and forward a null pointer instead of throwing ObjectDisposedException
issues.summary: All three SetTexture overloads pass &texture.GetRenderer(), and GetRenderer() returns *renderer_. Dispose resets renderer_, so a disposed texture yields a reference formed from an empty shared_ptr (formally undefined behaviour) and a null pointer reaches IEffectRenderer::BindTexture, BindTextureCube or BindTexture3D.
issues.public_contract: CNA ShaderEffect::SetTexture(int, TextureCube&), SetTexture(int, Texture3D&)

issues.title: An enabled zero-area ScissorRectangle draws unclipped on SDL_GPU, while every other rasterizing renderer clips everything
issues.summary: SDL_GPU's ApplyScissorForRef treats a zero width or height like a disabled scissor and uses the full target; XNA's contract (rasterise only inside the rectangle) means nothing is drawn, as the other renderers in CNA's shared scissor fixture do.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice.ScissorRectangle with zero width or height and RasterizerState.ScissorTestEnable = true

issues.title: WEBGPU always creates a Depth24PlusStencil8 back-buffer depth attachment but PresentationParameters keeps the requested DepthFormat
issues.summary: RecreateDepthTexture always uses Depth24PlusStencil8 and the renderer has no applied-format override, so PresentationParameters.DepthStencilFormat reports the requested format instead of the attachment that exists.
issues.public_contract: PresentationParameters.DepthStencilFormat after device creation/Reset on WEBGPU

issues.title: DIRECTX9 requests D3DPRESENT_INTERVAL_TWO without checking device support, and a Reset that rejects it leaves the device lost and retried every frame
issues.summary: PresentInterval::Two becomes D3DPRESENT_INTERVAL_TWO without a caps or windowed-mode check; when Reset rejects it the renderer marks the device lost and its recovery retries the same Reset every frame, skipping Draw and Present, while still reporting Two.
issues.public_contract: PresentationParameters.PresentationInterval = PresentInterval::Two on DIRECTX9

issues.title: DIRECTX9 never resolves multisampled render targets bound as a multiple-render-target set
issues.summary: SetRenderTargets binds each MSAA target's multisample surface but does not track an MRT set, so when the set is unbound no StretchRect resolve runs and the textures keep stale contents.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice::SetRenderTargets with two or more multisampled RenderTarget2D bindings on DIRECTX9

issues.title: GraphicsDevice::GetMaxTextureDimension() is documented as the renderer's real maximum, but every renderer returns an unqueried 16384 that the capability profile marks as known
issues.summary: No renderer reports a queried limit: every family returns the constant 16384 (no code in the repository queries GL_MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE or returns WebGPU's device limit), which the renderer capability profile nevertheless reports as a known limit.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice::GetMaxTextureDimension() (CNAEXT); RendererLimit::MaxTextureDimension in the renderer capability profile

issues.title: ContentManager::LoadXnbAssetUntyped refuses LZ4, which LoadXnbAsset<T> decodes
issues.summary: The untyped decoder behind EffectMaterial external references throws for MonoGame LZ4 payloads that the typed load path decodes. Its missing compressed-header guard was fixed on 2026-10-22.
issues.public_contract: ContentReader::ReadExternalReference() (untyped, CNAEXT; @throws ContentLoadException if the referenced compiled asset cannot be loaded) via ContentManager::LoadUntypedXnbReference / LoadXnbAssetUntyped

issues.title: ContentManager::Load<SoundEffect> lets its loose tier's System::NotSupportedException escape instead of ContentLoadException
issues.summary: The SoundEffect specialization of ContentManager::Load returns its loose reader's result without the generic template's wrapper, so a missing or undecodable sound file escapes as System::NotSupportedException rather than ContentLoadException.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Audio::SoundEffect> (documented to throw ContentLoadException when the asset cannot be loaded); XNA ContentManager.Load (ContentLoadException for open and read failures)

issues.title: ContentManager has no in-progress guard, so an .xnb external-reference cycle recurses until the stack overflows
issues.summary: Load<T> and LoadUntypedXnbReference cache an asset only after it has loaded, so an asset whose external reference leads back to itself re-enters the loader without bound and crashes instead of throwing ContentLoadException.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<T>(const std::string&), ContentManager::LoadUntypedXnbReference, ContentReader::ReadExternalReference<T>() and ContentReader::ReadExternalReference()

issues.title: ContentManager::Load<T> holds a plain reference to the loose-file reader, so RegisterTypeReader<T> during that reader's Read destroys it mid-call
issues.summary: Load<T> binds a LooseFileContentTypeReader<T>& to the object owned by the shared_ptr in typeReaders_; registering another reader for the same T while that Read runs releases the only owner.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::RegisterTypeReader<T>(std::unique_ptr<LooseFileContentTypeReader<T>>) and ContentManager::Load<T>

issues.title: DecompressXnbPayload grows the LZX output without bound and checks it against the declared size only after the last block
issues.summary: The LZX loop appends up to 64 KiB per block into an unbounded MemoryStream, so XnbReadLimits::maxDecompressedSize bounds only the declared size, not the memory the decoder actually allocates.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Internal::Xnb::DecompressXnbPayload and XnbReadLimits::maxDecompressedSize

issues.title: ContentReader::InnerReadObjectAny bypasses the object-nesting depth guard, so nested object-typed values recurse without limit
issues.summary: maxObjectNestingDepth is enforced only by the typed InnerReadObject<T>; Dictionary<String,Object> values, Model tags, shared resources and untyped roots dispatch through InnerReadObjectAny, which never counts depth.
issues.public_contract: ContentReader::ReadObject() (untyped), ContentReader::ReadAsset() (untyped), ContentReader::ReadSharedResources and XnbReadLimits::maxObjectNestingDepth

issues.title: Model::Draw indexes its bone scratch buffer with bone 0 even for a model with no bones
issues.summary: Model's three-argument constructor accepts an empty bone list, but Draw then reads sharedDrawBoneMatrices_[0] for every mesh without growing the thread-local vector, an unchecked out-of-range read or a stale matrix from an earlier model.
issues.public_contract: Model::Draw(const Matrix&, const Matrix&, const Matrix&) and Model::Model(GraphicsDevice*, std::vector<ModelBone*>, std::vector<ModelMesh*>)

issues.title: BlendMorphTargetsEXT indexes NormalDeltas and every per-vertex delta array without checking their lengths
issues.summary: The function validates only the weight count; a hand-built MorphTargetDataEXT whose NormalDeltas has fewer entries than targets, or whose delta arrays are shorter than the vertex count, is read out of range.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::BlendMorphTargetsEXT(const MorphTargetDataEXT&, const std::vector<float>&) and ApplyMorphWeightsEXT

issues.title: The .cnj Model reader truncates vertex and index sidecar sizes and never range-checks indices, where the SkinnedModel reader refuses the same input
issues.summary: ModelTypeReader and BuildModelMeshPartGeometryEXT derive vertex and index counts by integer division, discarding trailing bytes, and build the index buffer without checking indices against the vertex count; the SkinnedModel reader in the same file throws ContentLoadException for both. A mesh with a non-positive vertexStride is silently skipped, as it is in the SkinnedModel reader.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on .cnj Model documents (ModelTypeReader, BuildModelMeshPartGeometryEXT)

issues.title: The .cnj Model bones parser accepts forward or self parent indices and turns a malformed transform into identity
issues.summary: ParseCnjBoneArrayEXT keeps a transform only when it has exactly 16 numbers and the bone loop checks only that a parent index is in range, so a bone can name a later bone (or itself) as parent and CopyAbsoluteBoneTransformsTo reads an uncomputed slot.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on .cnj Model documents with a bones array; Model::CopyAbsoluteBoneTransformsTo

issues.title: FNA_KEYBOARD_USE_SCANCODES does not make Keyboard::GetState layout-independent; only the input bridge and GetKeyFromScancodeEXT honour it
issues.summary: CNA documents scancode mode as FNA's layout-independent key polling, but Keyboard::GetState reads the platform snapshot, which always resolves keys through the current layout, while GetKeyFromScancodeEXT switches to returning keys unchanged.
issues.public_contract: Keyboard::GetState() and Keyboard::GetKeyFromScancodeEXT(Keys) under the FNA_KEYBOARD_USE_SCANCODES=1 environment switch

issues.title: DIRECTX9 implements the window-to-logical transform but never registers for its window, so mouse and touch input ignore it
issues.summary: Input looks renderers up by window id through IGraphicsRenderer::GetForWindow; DIRECTX9 never calls RegisterForWindow, so Mouse::GetState, Mouse::SetPosition and touch pass raw window coordinates through under a virtual resolution, letterbox or display scale.
issues.public_contract: Mouse::GetState(), Mouse::SetPosition(int, int) and TouchPanel positions on the DIRECTX9 renderer

issues.title: Inside a letterbox bar, Mouse::GetState reports the raw window coordinate on renderers whose transform declines the point
issues.summary: EasyGL (every GL-family identity), SDL_GPU and WEBGPU decline points outside the presented rectangle, and Mouse and the input bridge then report the untransformed window coordinate, which can look like a valid game position. The presented rectangle is smaller than the window only under CnaPresentationMode::Letterbox (the default mode) when the window aspect differs from the back buffer's; Overscan, Stretch, NativeBackBuffer and FixedHeightDynamicWidth present a rectangle that covers the whole window, so only a pointer outside the window itself is declined there.
issues.public_contract: Mouse::GetState() and touch positions under a letterboxed or overscanned presentation

issues.title: Mouse::SetCaptureEXT, GetGlobalPositionEXT and WarpGlobalEXT let PlatformNotSupportedException escape on the terminal platform
issues.summary: The terminal mouse service throws PlatformNotSupportedException from SetCapture, TryGetGlobalPosition and SetGlobalPosition, and the Mouse wrappers do not catch it, although they document false (or (0, 0)) for an unsupported platform.
issues.public_contract: Mouse::SetCaptureEXT(bool), Mouse::GetGlobalPositionEXT(int&, int&), Mouse::WarpGlobalEXT(int, int)

issues.title: MediaPlayer flags ActiveSongChanged on every Play(Song*), even for the same song, and never for Play(const SongCollection&[, index])
issues.summary: Play(Song*) compares the queue's copy with the caller's pointer, so the event fires on every call, while playing a collection never raises it even when the active song changes.
issues.public_contract: MediaPlayer::ActiveSongChanged as raised by MediaPlayer::Play(Song*), Play(const SongCollection&) and Play(const SongCollection&, intcs)

issues.title: MediaPlayer::Play(Song*) records Duration and PlayCount on the caller's Song instead of the queued copy, and Stop never resets that PlayCount
issues.summary: Play(Song*) hands the caller's Song to PlaySong, so the mixer duration and a PlayCount increment land on the library or content Song while the queue's active copy keeps zero, contrary to MediaLibrary.cpp's comment.
issues.public_contract: Song::getDurationProperty() and Song::getPlayCountProperty() of the caller's Song and of MediaQueue::getActiveSongProperty() after MediaPlayer::Play(Song*)

issues.title: MediaPlayer::Play reports no error when a song cannot be played and can leave the player Playing with no track
issues.summary: A mixer load, track or start failure makes PlaySong return silently after the previous track was destroyed, so the state may stay Playing indefinitely, and a vanished file or a missing audio device throws non-XNA exceptions after the queue was replaced.
issues.public_contract: MediaPlayer::Play(Song*), Play(const SongCollection&), Play(const SongCollection&, intcs), MoveNext and MovePrevious: failure behaviour

issues.title: MediaPlayer::ProgramExit is documented as called at application exit, but nothing in CNA calls it
issues.summary: Unlike FNA, which hooks ProcessExit, CNA never calls MediaPlayer::ProgramExit outside an explicit C API export, so the music track is not released by CNA at exit and the header's statement is false.
issues.public_contract: MediaPlayer::ProgramExit() (CNAEXT) and the release of MediaPlayer's music track at exit

issues.title: Without a mixer (NULL audio) songs never end: queued copies carry no Duration, so the elapsed-time fallback never fires
issues.summary: LoadSong copies only a Song's file and name, so every queued Song has a zero Duration and, in builds without SOUND_ENABLED, DetectSongEndedByElapsedTime never reports an end: MediaPlayer stays Playing and the queue never advances.
issues.public_contract: MediaPlayer::Update() (via FrameworkDispatcher::Update), MediaState, ActiveSongChanged and queue advance under CNA_AUDIO_PLATFORM=NULL

issues.title: VideoPlayer::GetTexture lets the decoder's std::runtime_error escape, undocumented, and leaves the player Playing
issues.summary: A decode, packet, resample or I/O error mid-stream is thrown by VideoDecoder::NextFrame as std::runtime_error through GetTexture, whose header documents only ObjectDisposedException, and the player stays Playing so the next call tries again.
issues.public_contract: VideoPlayer::GetTexture() exceptions and the player state after a mid-stream decode failure

issues.title: VideoDecoder::SetVideoStream switches to another video stream mid-playback without seeking, so decoding resumes at a non-keyframe position
issues.summary: A genuine SetVideoTrackEXT switch during playback opens a fresh codec context at the demuxer's current position without a seek or flush; CNA's own comment explains that such a context fails on the next non-keyframe.
issues.public_contract: VideoPlayer::SetVideoTrackEXT(intcs) and Video::SetVideoTrackEXT(intcs) during playback

issues.title: VideoDecoder converts every YUV frame with one full-range BT.601 matrix: limited-range and BT.709 video decode with wrong levels and colours
issues.summary: The planar and NV12 converters ignore the frame's colour range and matrix, so ordinary limited-range video keeps black at 16 and white at 235, and BT.709 content is decoded with BT.601 coefficients.
issues.public_contract: VideoPlayer::GetTexture() frame contents (CNA::Internal::Media::VideoDecoder::NextFrame RGBA output)

issues.title: SoundBank::PlayCue destroys a fire-and-forget cue that is still playing five minutes after it started
issues.summary: SweepFireAndForget, run by every AudioEngine::Update and every PlayCue, removes still-playing or paused fire-and-forget cues older than kFireAndForgetSafetyNet (5 minutes), which stops long or looping cues such as music started with PlayCue.
issues.public_contract: SoundBank::PlayCue(const std::string&) and PlayCue(name, listener, emitter)

issues.title: DynamicSoundEffectInstance::SubmitFloatBufferEXT accepts empty and non-frame-aligned float buffers
issues.summary: SubmitBuffer now refuses partial frames as XNA does, but SubmitFloatBufferEXT still queues an empty buffer or a sample count that is not a whole number of channel frames, which SDL3 audio then drops and CNA's ALSA mixer plays shifted.
issues.public_contract: DynamicSoundEffectInstance::SubmitFloatBufferEXT(const std::vector<float>&[, int offset, int count])

issues.title: Microphone::Start reports Started even when the capture device could not be opened
issues.summary: Start swallows every exception from opening the device and ignores an unusable negotiated format, then sets State to Started; XNA's Start surfaces the native error as an exception.
issues.public_contract: Microphone::Start() and Microphone::getStateProperty()

issues.title: StorageDevice::EnsureStorageRoot caches the process-wide storage root in unsynchronised statics
issues.summary: The storage root is cached in a plain static bool and std::string with no lock or atomic, so two threads touching storage for the first time both resolve it and write the string concurrently, a data race, and a reader may see the flag before the string.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Storage::StorageDevice::GetStorageRootEXT() (“Absolute path to the storage root”) and every storage operation that resolves the root

issues.title: StorageDevice::getFreeSpaceProperty, getTotalSpaceProperty and getIsConnectedProperty pass the UTF-8 root to std::filesystem through the narrow path constructor
issues.summary: The three device properties hand the UTF-8 root string straight to fs::exists, fs::space and fs::path, which on Windows reinterpret it in the ANSI code page, so with a non-ASCII root they query a different path.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Storage::StorageDevice::getFreeSpaceProperty(), getTotalSpaceProperty() and getIsConnectedProperty()

issues.title: HttpNotificationChannel answers length-less and chunked pushes with 200 and reads request bodies of unbounded size
issues.summary: ReadRequestBody's comment says unreadable pushes are refused, but a request without Content-Length (chunked included) still gets 200 and is dropped, and the declared length is never bounded. A short body is now refused with 400.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Phone::Notification::HttpNotificationChannel listener: the HTTP status a push sender receives and the bytes raised as HttpNotificationReceived

issues.title: ToastPushNotificationMessage::SendAsync inserts Title and SubTitle into the toast XML without escaping
issues.summary: The toast body is built by string concatenation, so a Title or SubTitle containing an ampersand, a less-than sign or markup produces malformed or altered XML; the channel delivers the bytes unparsed.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Phone::Notification::ToastPushNotificationMessage::Title, SubTitle and SendAsync(const System::Uri&)

issues.title: Two open HttpNotificationChannel objects with the same name leave Find unable to locate one that is still open
issues.summary: Open assigns the registry entry for the name without checking for an existing channel, and when the later channel closes first it erases the name while the earlier one is still listening, so Find returns null for a live channel.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Phone::Notification::HttpNotificationChannel constructor, Open(), Close() and static Find(const std::string&)

issues.title: A handler that throws during HttpNotificationChannel::DispatchPendingNotificationsEXT discards every remaining notification of that batch
issues.summary: DispatchPendingNotificationsEXT moves the whole queue into a local vector before raising; an exception from a HttpNotificationReceived handler propagates and destroys the notifications not yet raised.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Phone::Notification::HttpNotificationChannel::DispatchPendingNotificationsEXT() and HttpNotificationReceived

issues.title: The phone notification channel and sender never initialise Winsock or link ws2_32, so on Windows they work only if something else did
issues.summary: modules/phone calls no WSAStartup and its library names no Winsock import library, so on Windows Open and SendAsync work only after another component initialised Winsock. Its INVALID_SOCKET checks were fixed on 2026-10-22.
issues.public_contract: HttpNotificationChannel::Open() and RawPushNotificationMessage / ToastPushNotificationMessage::SendAsync on Windows

issues.title: HttpNotificationChannel's listener spins without backoff on a persistent accept error
issues.summary: When accept fails while the channel is still listening (EMFILE or ENFILE when descriptors run out, ENOBUFS), the listener thread retries at once with no delay, so a persistent failure makes it loop at full speed.
issues.public_contract: HttpNotificationChannel::Close() and the channel's internal listener thread

issues.title: LocalGamerServicesStore maps distinct gamertags to one achievements file when they differ only in characters outside A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-'
issues.summary: SanitizeStoreFileNameComponent replaces every other byte with an underscore, so gamertags such as "Ann B" and "Ann_B", or two same-length non-ASCII names, share one achievements file and see each other's achievements.
issues.public_contract: SignedInGamer::AwardAchievement and GetAchievements persistence (CNA::Internal::GamerServices::SaveEarnedAchievementEXT, LoadEarnedAchievementsEXT, SanitizeStoreFileNameComponent)

issues.title: NetworkSession::GamerJoined reports a gamer added with AddLocalGamer twice to a handler subscribed between that call and the next Update
issues.summary: AddLocalGamer inserts the new gamer into AllGamers at once and queues its GamerJoin event for the next Update, while subscribing replays GamerJoined for every gamer already in AllGamers, so a handler subscribed in that window is called twice for the new gamer.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Net::NetworkSession::GamerJoined (subscription replay) with NetworkSession::AddLocalGamer and the transport's AddRemoteGamer

issues.title: A joined SystemLink session answers LAN discovery for itself, so Find lists the session once per member
issues.summary: Every SystemLink session, including a joined one, registers with discovery and ReplyToQuery ignores IsHost, so Find lists a session once per member; joining through a client's entry is refused by that client instead of reaching the host.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Net::NetworkSession::Find and Join for NetworkSessionType::SystemLink (ENetDiscoveryService::RegisterHost and ReplyToQuery; ENetBackend::StartHosting and HandleClientHello)

issues.title: Setting Game::IsMouseVisible throws PlatformException on the terminal platform when the terminal reports mouse input
issues.summary: Game::setIsMouseVisibleProperty forwards to IPlatformMouse::SetCursorVisible whenever a window and a mouse service exist; the terminal platform supplies a TerminalMouse whenever stdin and stdout are both terminals (TerminalCapabilities::canQuery is isatty(stdin), independent of whether the emulator answers any query), and that mouse always throws.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Game::setIsMouseVisibleProperty(bool); CNA::Platform::IPlatformMouse::SetCursorVisible(bool) on the terminal platform

issues.title: The Headless and Terminal window constructors accept BorderlessFullscreen although their own SetFullscreenMode refuses it
issues.summary: Both capability-minimal windows store WindowDescription::fullscreenMode directly at construction instead of routing it through SetFullscreenMode, so a window created in BorderlessFullscreen reports that mode though the platform's capability is false.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Platform::IPlatform::CreateWindow(const WindowDescription&) and IPlatformWindow::GetFullscreenMode()/SetFullscreenMode() on the Headless and Terminal platforms

issues.title: Sdl3Platform reports the nativeFileDialog capability on iOS and web builds, where SDL has no usable file-dialog backend
issues.summary: The SDL3 platform sets nativeFileDialog unconditionally, so on iOS and the web the platform says a dialog can be shown while FileDialog::getIsSupportedProperty says it cannot, and FileDialog::Show* reach SDL, which fails the request.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Platform::PlatformCapabilities::nativeFileDialog as reported by the SDL3 platform (Sdl3Platform::GetCapabilities); CNA::Devices::FileDialog::getIsSupportedProperty and ShowOpenFile, ShowSaveFile, ShowOpenFolder

issues.title: The SDL3 file-dialog and tray-entry trampolines call application callbacks without a try/catch, so a throwing handler unwinds through SDL's C code
issues.summary: ResultTrampoline and EntryClickTrampoline invoke the application's std::function directly from SDL C callbacks, so an exception escaping it crosses SDL frames (undefined behaviour, typically std::terminate).
issues.public_contract: CNA::Devices::FileDialog result callbacks and CNA::Devices::SystemTray entry-click callbacks on the SDL3 platform

issues.title: Core's build files still carry dependencies its sources dropped: -lembind on Emscripten and a link probe that tolerates SDL3
issues.summary: modules/core/CMakeLists.txt still adds -lembind for every Emscripten consumer although the browser preference reader was rewritten with EM_JS to avoid embind, and probe_core still permits SDL3 although core no longer uses SDL.
issues.public_contract: The link interface of cna_core (CNA::Core) on Emscripten, and the probe_core link-closure check

issues.title: Stub_Smoke links SDL3::SDL3 unconditionally, so STUB + tests cannot be configured with CNA_ENABLE_SDL=OFF
issues.summary: The STUB renderer's smoke-test macro links SDL3::SDL3 in both branches and its source includes the SDL3 header, while CNA_ENABLE_SDL=OFF is a supported configuration; with STUB selected and tests on, the SDL-free configuration has no SDL3 target to link.
issues.public_contract: CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER=STUB with CNA_BUILD_TESTS=ON and CNA_ENABLE_SDL=OFF

issues.title: CNA_ENABLE_VIDEO=AUTO accepts any pkg-config FFmpeg, but VideoDecoder.cpp needs the FFmpeg 5.1 channel-layout API
issues.summary: The FFmpeg probe states no minimum version while VideoDecoder.cpp uses AVCodecContext::ch_layout and swr_alloc_set_opts2, so a host with older FFmpeg development packages enables video at configure time and then fails to compile.
issues.public_contract: CMake option CNA_ENABLE_VIDEO (AUTO, the default, and ON) and the cna_video_ffmpeg target

issues.title: cmake/toolchains/mingw-w64.cmake falls back to the i686 compiler but keeps CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR x86_64, so 32-bit and 64-bit trees share one persistent SDL install directory
issues.summary: When x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc is missing the toolchain silently selects i686-w64-mingw32 yet still declares x86_64, which names the .sdl-prebuilt-Windows-x86_64 install; since the SDL build manifest records the compiler, the two trees no longer reuse each other's SDL but rebuild that one install in turn. Its header comment also still requires a pre-built SDL on CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH.
issues.public_contract: cmake/toolchains/mingw-w64.cmake (MinGW-w64 cross toolchain file)

issues.title: Link-closure tests pass --build-dir ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}, so when CNA is added as a subproject of a Makefiles build they look for link.txt in the consumer's build root and always skip
issues.summary: The probe targets are defined in CNA's own root directory, whose binary directory is a subdirectory of the consumer's build tree; under a Makefiles generator the checker is pointed at the top-level build root instead and never finds CMakeFiles/<probe>.dir/link.txt (Ninja trees are now read through ninja and are unaffected).
issues.public_contract: cmake/Tests/ModuleProbes.cmake ModuleLinkClosure_* --build-dir argument

issues.title: Software_XnaLineCoverage passes when a scene differs from the XNA reference: run-oracle-corpus-diff-software.sh fails only on render errors
issues.summary: The CTest described as the exact Software regression for the two aliased-line scenes runs a script that prints DIFF for a pixel mismatch and still exits 0; only a missing reference or a failed render makes it fail.
issues.public_contract: CTest Software_XnaLineCoverage (modules/renderers/software/examples/CMakeLists.txt)

issues.title: Delta-maintained diagnostics gauges such as Audio/AllocatedVoices drift after a runtime OFF window
issues.summary: GaugeHandle::Add discards deltas while the runtime mode is OFF, so a gauge kept with GAUGE_ADD(+1/-1), such as Audio/AllocatedVoices, stays wrong (too high, or negative) after statistics are re-enabled, until mixer shutdown resets it.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Diagnostics::GaugeHandle::Add and CNA_DIAGNOSTICS_GAUGE_ADD across SetRuntimeMode(Mode::Off); the documented meaning of Audio/AllocatedVoices

issues.title: On Emscripten a diagnostics frame excludes the requestAnimationFrame wait, so FrameSample.framesPerSecond is a work rate there
issues.summary: The web loop opens the frame scope inside EmscriptenMainLoopCallback and waits for the next animation frame after it returns, so web frame durations and FPS exclude pacing, unlike the native Tick the documentation describes.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Diagnostics::FrameSample (durationNs, framesPerSecond) as published by Game's frame scope

issues.title: Inspector ServerHello.graphicsRenderer reports the compile-time default renderer, not the one GraphicsRendererSelection actually created
issues.summary: The Inspector session names the build's default renderer identity, so in a multi-renderer build where a preference, the environment variable or a fallback selects another renderer, the Session view shows the wrong one.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Inspector::HelloResponse::graphicsRenderer (the Session view's renderer) versus CNA::GraphicsRendererSelection::GetActive()

issues.title: A diagnostics name or resource label longer than 4,096 bytes makes every Inspector snapshot or event batch that contains it fail with LimitExceeded
issues.summary: Diagnostics accepts names up to 1 MiB and labels of any length, but the Inspector protocol caps strings at 4,096 bytes and refuses the whole response, so one long name breaks the affected Inspector views for the rest of the process.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Inspector protocol v1 SnapshotResponse and EventsResponse encoding (ProtocolCodec::Encode) over diagnostics provider v1 data

issues.title: Agent::Stop can wait up to about six seconds for a connection that the accept loop takes around the time Stop runs
issues.summary: Stop shuts down only a client already published as activeClient_, and the worker never re-checks stopping_ after accepting. A connection accepted just before Stop, or during the accept poll of up to 200 ms that follows Stop setting stopping_, is therefore never shut down, and join waits on that client's handshake reads, up to 3 s for the header and 3 s for the payload.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Inspector::Agent::Stop() and ~Agent()

issues.title: cna_graphics_resource_get_graphics_device returns CNA_RESULT_INVALID_HANDLE for every resource created on a caller-created GraphicsDevice
issues.summary: A resource made on a device from cna_graphics_device_create carries that device's handle as its owner token, and the route passes it to the game-only BorrowGameGraphicsDevice, so asking such a valid resource for its device always fails.
issues.public_contract: cna_graphics_resource_get_graphics_device(CNA_Handle resource, CNA_Handle* out_graphics_device) (CNA/C/graphics_resource.h) for resources created on a cna_graphics_device_create device

issues.title: audio.h and AUDIO.md call cna_dynamic_sound_effect_instance_submit_buffer safe from a producer thread, but every call off the creation thread returns CNA_RESULT_THREAD
issues.summary: The submission routes resolve the instance through HandleRegistry::Get, which refuses any thread other than the handle's creation thread, so the documented canonical producer-thread usage fails; AUDIO.md's own threading section states the stricter rule.
issues.public_contract: cna_dynamic_sound_effect_instance_submit_buffer, cna_dynamic_sound_effect_instance_submit_float_buffer_ext

issues.title: docs/c-api/HANDLES.md documents CNA_RESULT_SHUTTING_DOWN for a closing or closed runtime, but no C API route ever returns it
issues.summary: abi.h defines CNA_RESULT_SHUTTING_DOWN and HANDLES.md maps a closing runtime to it, but no route returns it and the registry has no shutdown state, so a stale handle answers CNA_RESULT_INVALID_HANDLE.
issues.public_contract: CNA_RESULT_SHUTTING_DOWN (abi.h); the HANDLES.md validation table

issues.title: GraphicsRendererSelection::IsLatched() is documented to latch when the first GraphicsDevice begins construction; it latches only on successful resolution
issues.summary: The header comment on IsLatched() says the selection latches when the first GraphicsDevice begins construction, but GraphicsDevice::resolveRenderer latches only after a renderer has been created, so a resolution that fails before any renderer exists leaves the choice open. (A constructor that fails after resolution has already latched: CNA-BUG-095.)
issues.public_contract: CNA::GraphicsRendererSelection::IsLatched() as documented in CNA/GraphicsRendererSelection.hpp

issues.title: docs/framework-design.md says the Framework.Design registration associates the twelve value types with ordered descriptor collections; registerConverter registers only converter factories
issues.summary: registerConverter registers only a TypeConverterAttribute for each of the twelve math types, while CNA's design note says the registration associates the types with converter factories and ordered descriptor collections. The ordered descriptors exist only inside each converter, so the sentence overstates what the registration does.
issues.public_contract: The registration described in docs/framework-design.md, and System::ComponentModel::TypeDescriptor::GetProperties for the XNA math value types

issues.title: content_readers.h documentation names cna_get_last_error_message, which does not exist
issues.summary: The Doxygen of cna_object_dictionary_ext_copy_value tells callers to read 'the message cna_get_last_error_message returns', a function declared nowhere; the C API's error accessors are the cna_error_* functions in core.h.
issues.public_contract: cna_object_dictionary_ext_copy_value documentation in CNA/C/content_readers.h

issues.title: cna_game_destroy's comment says Shutdown has disposed the canonical graphics device; it has not
issues.summary: A comment in cna_game_destroy claims CGame::Shutdown already disposed the game's canonical GraphicsDevice so C subscribers saw its Disposing event, but Game::Dispose(true) never disposes the Game-owned device.
issues.public_contract: cna_game_destroy teardown order (maintainer documentation in CnaCApiRuntime.cpp)

issues.title: RunContentCompiler documentation says XNB output writers are registered only for --format xnb; they are registered on every run
issues.summary: ContentCompiler.hpp ties the coordinator's XNB writer registration to '--format xnb', but tools/content/content.cpp registers them unconditionally before freezing the registry.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Content::Pipeline::RunContentCompiler (both overloads: pre-built registry and registry factory)

issues.title: Audio comments describe behaviour the code does not have: SoundEffect::Play's instance limit, FireAndForgetPanState freeing and SoundEffectReader's WAV route
issues.summary: SoundEffect.hpp promises that Play returns false at an instance limit CNA does not implement, and two internal comments in the audio and content modules contradict the code next to them.
issues.public_contract: SoundEffect::Play() and SoundEffect::Play(float, float, float) documentation; maintainer comments in SoundEffect.cpp, SoundEffectInstance.hpp and SoundEffectContentTypeReader.hpp

issues.title: docs/input-backend.md names a SdlInputBridge ProcessEvent overload and src/Input/... paths that do not exist at TARGET
issues.summary: docs/input-backend.md describes a raw SdlInputBridge::ProcessEvent overload that the SDL-shaped test-double retirement (PLAT-90) removed, and cites src/Input/Internal/ and src/Input/Xna/ paths; the input sources live under modules/input/src. (The comment naming a nonexistent Game::UpdateInput() in the SDL3 platform is published separately as CNA-BUG-237.)
issues.public_contract: Maintainer documentation of the input pump: the EnsureControllerSubsystem comment in the SDL3 platform, and docs/input-backend.md

issues.title: A GraphicsDevice maintainer comment still says only DIRECTX9 drives the device status, although WEBGPU raises device events too
issues.summary: The public DeviceLost documentation and two maintainer comments were corrected, but the comment inside getGraphicsDeviceStatusProperty still says only Direct3D 9 calls the device-event callback; WebGPU calls it from its context-loss hooks.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice::getGraphicsDeviceStatusProperty() maintainer documentation

issues.title: Two EasyGL comments still describe runtime GL profiles (phase P11) as future work
issues.summary: EasyGLRendererDescriptor.cpp's file header and the CNA_RENDERER_SHARED_EASYGL comment in RendererCombinations.cmake say a runtime GL profile is still to come, although both files implement or record it.
issues.public_contract: Maintainer comments in EasyGLRendererDescriptor.cpp and cmake/RendererCombinations.cmake (EasyGL identities sharing one binary)

issues.title: StubTextureRenderer's comment says GetData() is accepted and discarded, but the inherited default refuses the read
issues.summary: The class comment on StubTextureRenderer says SetData()/GetData() are accepted no-op defaults, while the ITextureRenderer::GetData default it inherits returns false, which the shared Texture2D layer turns into NotSupportedException.
issues.public_contract: Maintainer comment on CNA::Internal::Renderers::Stub::StubTextureRenderer

issues.title: plans/plan_xnb.md still says 'Nothing here is implemented yet - every row starts ⬜' beneath a status banner that records every XNB reader phase but H and I complete
issues.summary: The XNB design note misc/xnb.md, which made the same contradiction, was removed on 2026-10-25; its companion task list, now the plan of record, still opens with a banner calling Phases 0 to G complete and then states that nothing in it is implemented.
issues.public_contract: plans/plan_xnb.md, the task plan and status record of the ContentManager / ContentTypeReaderManager .xnb reader

issues.title: docs/graphics-renderer-feature-matrix.md calls itself up to date but still lists EasyGL's ReferenceStencil test as a known failure, contradicting its own table row
issues.summary: The matrix's ReferenceStencil row says EasyGL passes (remeasured 2026-09-09), but its failure baseline still lists the test, although EasyGL was fixed on 2026-08-29.
issues.public_contract: docs/graphics-renderer-feature-matrix.md ('Master, up-to-date cross-renderer feature matrix') and the documented status of GraphicsDevice::setReferenceStencilProperty on the EasyGL family

issues.title: cna_define_shared_runtime_deferred's comment says cna_graphics_ext and cna_devices_ext exist only with CNA_CNAEXT; modules/CMakeLists.txt always creates both
issues.summary: The shared-library composition keeps an if(TARGET) filter justified by a comment that the extension targets are optional, but both are defined unconditionally, so the comment misstates the module model.
issues.public_contract: cmake/SharedRuntimeLibrary.cmake cna_define_shared_runtime_deferred (composition of libcna.so under CNA_SHARED_LIBRARY)

issues.title: CHECKLIST.md's per-file port checklist still says 'FNA still wins on semantics', contradicting the rule in CLAUDE.md that XNA wins where the two disagree
issues.summary: The checklist every ported file is reviewed against keeps the old tie-break, while CNA's contributor rules record the owner decision of 2026-09-04 that measured XNA behaviour wins over FNA's.
issues.public_contract: CHECKLIST.md (per-file port checklist, XNA 4.0 API compliance section) and the behaviour-authority rule in CLAUDE.md

issues.title: docs/physical-modules.md has no row for modules/platform, omits the platform and diagnostics edges of runtime, input, audio and devices-ext, and says top-level examples/ holds only examples/golden
issues.summary: CNA's physical-module map, which check_renderer_identities.py keeps under count control, never mentions the platform module that input, runtime, audio and devices-ext link, and misdescribes the top-level examples directory.
issues.public_contract: docs/physical-modules.md, the Framework modules table (direct CNA dependencies and Sharp Runtime components per module) and its description of the repository layout

issues.title: docs/physical-modules.md's Sharp Runtime column omits components that four modules link: Uri for phone and media, Collections.Core for input, Resources for content
issues.summary: CNA's module table gives phone Core.Base and Collections.Core, input Core.Base, and media and content Core.Base and IO, while the modules' CMake files link Uri (phone, media), Collections.Core (input) and Resources (content, plus Security.Cryptography privately).
issues.public_contract: docs/physical-modules.md module table, Sharp Runtime column (rows modules/phone, input, media and content)

issues.title: A comment in Sdl3Platform.cpp refers to a Game::UpdateInput() that does not exist
issues.summary: The SDL3 platform explains its lazy controller-subsystem start by saying Game::UpdateInput() pumps the input services only once the subsystem is initialised, but Game has no UpdateInput(); the per-frame controller pump lives in Game::PollEvents.
issues.public_contract: Source comment in CNA::Platform::Sdl3::Sdl3Platform::EnsureControllerSubsystem

issues.title: docs/devices-event-contract.md and docs/devices-thread-safety.md describe sensor behaviour the code no longer has
issues.summary: The event contract says the Android bridge swallows handler exceptions silently, and the thread-safety document misnames the counter guard for two sensors and calls same-instance Start/Dispose safe while its known-gap section says otherwise.
issues.public_contract: docs/devices-event-contract.md section 6 (exception semantics) and docs/devices-thread-safety.md (per-class guarantees and the known gap)

issues.title: Source comments still say StorageDevice reaches the platform or the SDL preference path
issues.summary: IPlatformFileSystem::GetPreferencesPath is documented as backing StorageDevice and several comments cite storage as a reason for the ambient platform, but storage has no platform dependency and GetPreferencesPath has no production caller.
issues.public_contract: Doxygen of CNA::Platform::IPlatformFileSystem::GetPreferencesPath, CNA::Platform::GetCurrentPlatform, Game::GetPlatformEXT and the CApi_StorageSmoke registration comment

issues.title: docs/gltf-limitations.md says CNA reverses the winding of mirrored glTF placements; the importer leaves it unchanged
issues.summary: The limitations table's mirrored-transform row says 'CNA reverses it and marks the placement', while ContentModelLoaders.cpp, the import report (mirrored-winding-unapplied) and GltfMirroringTests.cpp all establish that the winding is not reversed.
issues.public_contract: docs/gltf-limitations.md (section 2, the 'A mirrored node transform' row)

issues.title: docs/graphics-resource-lifetime.md says existing XNA resources hold a unique_ptr renderer and names a non-existent ITexture2DRenderer; Texture2D, Texture3D and TextureCube hold shared_ptr renderers and Texture2D's public copies share one
issues.summary: The document's Ownership Model gives unique_ptr renderer ownership for existing XNA resources, a list its scope sentence extends to Texture2D and RenderTarget2D, and knows only one kind of sharing: an internal record on non-copyable modern resources. Texture2D, Texture3D and TextureCube hold shared_ptr renderers, and Texture2D's public copies share the renderer and CPU shadow.
issues.public_contract: docs/graphics-resource-lifetime.md section 1 (Ownership Model) against Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::Texture2D (copy constructor, copy assignment, GetRendererWeak, GetCpuPixelsWeak), Texture3D and TextureCube

issues.title: The EasyGL L7 policy and report justify zero tolerance with 'all 137 renderable assets' while the report's own fields record 140 captured, byte-identical assets
issues.summary: The EasyGL L7 policy's justification, copied into its report, cites 137 renderable assets while the report records 148 assets, 140 byte-identical captures and 8 rejections.
issues.public_contract: tests/gltf-l7/easygl-policy.json and docs/gltf-l7-corpus-report.json goldenComparison.justification (the OPENGLES3/EasyGL L7 tolerance rationale)

issues.title: PacketWriter::Write(Color)'s doc comment still says ReadColor reads four floats and is not the inverse of Write(Color)
issues.summary: ReadColor reads the four bytes Write(Color) writes, a test asserts the round trip, and ReadColor's own header comment now says so, but PacketWriter.hpp still describes a four-float asymmetry preserved from 'upstream', which XNA 4.0 does not have.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Net::PacketReader::ReadColor() and PacketWriter::Write(Color) Doxygen

issues.title: LocalNetworkGamer::SendData in a Local or LocalWithLeaderboards session silently drops every packet, so neither the sender nor another local gamer ever receives it
issues.summary: NetworkSession::Update raises PacketSend events only when real networking is enabled (SystemLink, or a service-backed PlayerMatch/Ranked session), so SendData in a Local or LocalWithLeaderboards session reports success and delivers nothing, although SendData is documented to reach every gamer in the session, the sender included.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Net::LocalNetworkGamer::SendData, ReceiveData and getIsDataAvailableProperty in a NetworkSession of type Local or LocalWithLeaderboards

issues.title: docs/directx9-renderer.md says the DIRECTX9 custom ShaderEffect phase (D9-11) has not been started; plans/plan_dx9.md records it fully closed on 2026-07-15
issues.summary: The DIRECTX9 renderer document lists custom ShaderEffect (D9-11) as not started, while the plan it points to records D9-110, D9-111 and D9-112 all closed on 2026-07-15.
issues.public_contract: docs/directx9-renderer.md, the gap list of the DIRECTX9 renderer document

issues.title: ExitingEventArgs is documented as the data of Game.Exiting but nothing delivers it, and this non-XNA type carries no CNAEXT marker
issues.summary: The header says ExitingEventArgs provides data for Game.Exiting, yet Game::Exiting is typed with plain EventArgs, nothing constructs the type, and it is not tagged CNAEXT although XNA 4.0 has no such class.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::ExitingEventArgs (ExitingEventArgs.hpp) and Game::Exiting

issues.title: Comments and docs say GpuDrawParams::specularEnabled is read by no renderer and DIRECTX9's specular variants are blocked, but D3D9EffectDraw and Fna3dDraw read it
issues.summary: IGraphicsRenderer.hpp says no renderer reads GpuDrawParams::specularEnabled, and two DirectX9 headers and docs/directx9-renderer.md call the specular and per-pixel-lighting variants unreachable, although DIRECTX9 and FNA3D read the fields.
issues.public_contract: GpuDrawParams::specularEnabled and preferPerPixelLighting (IGraphicsRenderer.hpp) and the DIRECTX9 shader-dispatch documentation

issues.title: CnaTests is linked with both -sJSPI=1 and -sASYNCIFY=1 on Emscripten; emcc lets the later flag win, so the JSPI its CMake comment relies on is silently replaced by Asyncify
issues.summary: UnitTests.cmake adds -sJSPI=1 to CnaTests, but BuildPerformance.cmake then adds -sASYNCIFY=1 through cna_emscripten_asyncify; emcc keeps the later flag, so CnaTests is Asyncify-linked and the comment's reason (no Asyncify with wasm exceptions) is stale.
issues.public_contract: CnaTests' Emscripten link options (cmake/UnitTests.cmake and cmake/BuildPerformance.cmake)

issues.title: TerminalMouse::SetPosition throws PlatformException although IPlatformMouse::SetPosition documents no exception, so XNA's Mouse.SetPosition throws on the terminal platform
issues.summary: IPlatformMouse::SetPosition documents no exception, but TerminalMouse::SetPosition always throws PlatformException and Mouse::SetPosition calls it unguarded, so the XNA re-centre-the-cursor idiom throws once the terminal platform reports mouse input.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Input::Mouse::SetPosition(int, int) on the terminal platform (TerminalMouse::SetPosition)

issues.title: A join beyond MaxGamers is not refused: the host sends ServerWelcome, AddRemoteGamer throws Session is full!, and the receive path's catch-all drops it, so the joiner never sees SessionFull
issues.summary: HandleClientHello sends ServerWelcome and registers wire ids before AddRemoteGamer checks capacity; the receive path swallows the exception, so an over-capacity client stays connected and NetworkSessionJoinError::SessionFull is never produced.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Net::NetworkSession::Join on a full host (ENetBackend HandleClientHello, NetworkSession::AddRemoteGamer, NetworkSessionJoinError::SessionFull)

issues.title: cna_validate_renderer_identity_selection says it checks the per-identity CNA_RENDERER_<X> switches, but only retired names are checked: a misspelled or unknown switch is never read and the platform's default renderer is configured silently
issues.summary: The validator's comment promises to check the CNA_RENDERER_<X> switches, but it only loops over retired names; -DCNA_RENDERER_D3D9=ON or a typo is neither an error nor honoured, and the platform's default renderer is configured without a diagnostic.
issues.public_contract: cmake/RendererIdentities.cmake::cna_validate_renderer_identity_selection and the per-identity CNA_RENDERER_<X> configure switches

issues.title: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md tell contributors to throw std::runtime_error after disposal, while the public layer throws System::ObjectDisposedException at 50 sites in the graphics module alone
issues.summary: CNA's contributor instruction files give one rule for a disposed object (throw std::runtime_error), while the graphics, audio, media and net modules throw System::ObjectDisposedException, XNA's exception for that case.
issues.public_contract: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, the IDisposable section ("throw std::runtime_error if used after disposal")

issues.title: README.md calls the CNAEXT purity check "a dedicated CMake build option", but CNA_STRICT_XNA_API is a compile definition on two harness targets and no CMake option exists
issues.summary: The README describes the compile-time CNAEXT purity check as a dedicated CMake build option; cmake/Harnesses.cmake only sets the CNA_STRICT_XNA_API compile definition on two check targets, and passing -DCNA_STRICT_XNA_API=ON to CMake does nothing.
issues.public_contract: README.md, the Verification methodology bullet on the CNAEXT purity check

issues.title: SoundEffect::Play(volume, pitch, pan) clamps pitch, does not check volume and returns false when disposed, where XNA 4.0 throws
issues.summary: XNA 4.0's SoundEffect.Play(float, float, float) throws ObjectDisposedException when disposed and ArgumentOutOfRangeException for volume or pitch out of range; CNA returns false when disposed, clamps pitch and passes volume through.
issues.public_contract: SoundEffect::Play(float volume, float pitch, float pan) and the C route cna_sound_effect_play_with_settings

issues.title: The glTF importer still refuses a file that requires KHR_materials_specular, although its own registry note says every PBR renderer samples both specular maps
issues.summary: GltfImportCore's registry keeps KHR_materials_specular unclaimed, so extensionsRequired refuses such a file, while the same record and the renderer inventory test state that every PBR renderer samples both maps; the record names no limit, and two tests still give a stale reason.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager glTF import (and the offline converters) for files that list KHR_materials_specular in extensionsRequired or extensionsUsed; the extension-support registry (FindGltfExtensionEXT, IsGltfExtensionSupportedEXT)

issues.title: An XNB BoundingSphere or Model mesh sphere with a negative radius fails to load, although XNA and CNA's own XNB writer accept it
issues.summary: ContentReader::ReadBoundingSphere builds the sphere through the validating BoundingSphere(Vector3, float) constructor, so a negative radius in a .xnb throws System::ArgumentException, where XNA's reader assigns Center and Radius as stored.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load of an .xnb holding a BoundingSphere (BoundingSphereReader) or a Model (the per-mesh bounding sphere)

issues.title: The sibling version check accepts sharp-runtime's v0.1.0 tag, but this snapshot needs sharp-runtime APIs added after it (a FileStream constructor and XmlSerializer property members), so such a build fails to compile instead of failing configuration
issues.summary: cmake/DependencyVersions.cmake requires sharp-runtime 0.1.0 or a later 0.1.x patch, which the v0.1.0 tag satisfies, yet StorageContainer.cpp calls a FileStream constructor sharp-runtime gained in c6984ece and XmlSerializationEXT.hpp registers properties through MakeProperty, added in f990d074; the tag has neither, and sharp-runtime's next still declares 0.1.0.
issues.public_contract: Configuring and building CNA at this snapshot against a sharp-runtime checkout that declares version 0.1.0 (CNA_CHECK_DEPENDENCY_VERSIONS, on by default)

issues.title: On FNA3D's SDL_GPU driver a TextureCube, Texture3D or mipmapped Texture2D changed between two draws of one frame shows its new contents in the earlier draw too
issues.summary: SDL_GPU and WEBGPU now order a texture upload after the queued draws that sample it, so SpriteSortMode::Immediate and other mid-frame SetData calls keep XNA's per-draw contents there; FNA3D's SDL_GPU driver still submits uploads ahead of the frame's draws and keeps the old contents only for a whole write of a single-level 2D texture.
issues.public_contract: Texture2D, TextureCube and Texture3D SetData between two draws of one frame (including two Draw calls of one SpriteSortMode::Immediate SpriteBatch) on the FNA3D renderer when FNA3D runs its SDL_GPU driver
