issues.title: FNA3D's Direct3D 11 driver cannot build some valid compiled effects: a ps_3_0 shader that reads two vertex outputs packed in one register fails to compile, and the integer input-layout rewrite can retype the wrong semantic
issues.summary: the MojoShader code behind FNA3D's Direct3D 11 driver, in CNA's pinned fork, names a struct member that does not exist when a ps_3_0 shader reads, from one register, semantics the vertex shader wrote to separate registers, so the generated HLSL fails to compile; and it finds the semantic of an integer vertex element by substring, so DEPTH1 can match an earlier DEPTH10 and swap their integer and float declarations.
issues.public_contract: Compiled XNA effects (Effect Framework bytecode) drawn on the FNA3D renderer when FNA3D runs its Direct3D 11 driver (Windows; FNA3D tries its SDL_GPU driver first, or the driver is selected with FNA3D_FORCE_DRIVER)

issues.title: RendererFeature::MultiSampleMask misreports EasyGL without glSampleMaski (OPENGLES3 on an OpenGL ES 3.0 context, WEBGL2) and WEBGPU over wgpu-native's Metal driver
issues.summary: The feature is defined so that Unsupported means a mask has no effect and Supported means any mask is applied, but EasyGL without glSampleMaski answers Unsupported while it throws NotSupportedException for every mask other than all ones, and WEBGPU over wgpu-native's Metal driver answers Supported while it refuses a partial mask; a program that trusts the answer either fails at the draw or never learns that the mask is refused.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice::GetRendererFeatureSupportEXT(CNA::RendererFeature::MultiSampleMask) and the C constant CNA_RENDERER_FEATURE_MULTI_SAMPLE_MASK, against BlendState/GraphicsDevice MultiSampleMask on a multisampled target

issues.title: CNA::Logger serialises writes but not level changes, and a sink must not call back into the logger
issues.summary: minimumLevel_ is read and written without synchronisation and the sink runs under a non-recursive mutex, so changing the level while other threads log is a data race and a sink that logs deadlocks; the header states neither limit.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Logger::SetMinimumLevel, GetMinimumLevel, Log and its helpers, SetSink and ResetSink

issues.title: Game::ShowMissingRequirementMessage is a virtual hook that nothing in CNA calls
issues.summary: XNA 4.0's Game.Run catches NoSuitableGraphicsDeviceException and NoAudioHardwareException and offers them to ShowMissingRequirementMessage before rethrowing; CNA declares the virtual but Game::Run never invokes it, so an override has no effect.
issues.public_contract: virtual bool Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Game::ShowMissingRequirementMessage(const std::exception&)

issues.title: DrawableGameComponent loads content once in Initialize and never follows the graphics device service
issues.summary: It never subscribes to IGraphicsDeviceService.DeviceCreated/DeviceDisposing (OnDeviceCreated is dead code), whereas XNA 4.0 requires the service, reloads on DeviceCreated and unloads on DeviceDisposing.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::DrawableGameComponent::Initialize(), LoadContent(), UnloadContent()

issues.title: GraphicsDeviceManager never calls its FindBestDevice, RankDevices or CanResetDevice virtuals
issues.summary: The three XNA selection hooks are implemented (as a default GraphicsDeviceInformation, a no-op and 'device exists') but CreateDevice and ApplyChanges do not consult them, so overriding them has no effect on device selection or reset.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::GraphicsDeviceManager::FindBestDevice(bool), RankDevices(std::vector<GraphicsDeviceInformation>&), CanResetDevice(const GraphicsDeviceInformation&)

issues.title: CNA public headers still export Sharp Runtime's unprefixed CONTAINS and INTERNAL macros through SharpRuntimeHelper.hpp
issues.summary: 91 headers under modules/*/include include SharpRuntime/SharpRuntimeHelper.hpp, which defines CONTAINS(STRING, SUBSTR) and an empty INTERNAL, so a game translation unit that includes such a CNA header cannot use those spellings as identifiers.
issues.public_contract: Any CNA public header that includes SharpRuntime/SharpRuntimeHelper.hpp (for example SoundEffect.hpp, AudioEngine.hpp, AudioCategory.hpp)

issues.title: Sub-pixel SpriteBatch destinations reach only EasyGL and SOFTWARE; every other renderer truncates them to whole pixels
issues.summary: SpriteBatch forwards float destinations through ISpriteBatchRenderer's sub-pixel Draw overload, whose default truncates toward zero into an integer Rectangle; only the EasyGL and SOFTWARE sprite renderers override it.
issues.public_contract: SpriteBatch::Draw / DrawString with fractional positions or scales; ISpriteBatchRenderer::Draw(texture, float x, float y, float w, float h, ...)

issues.title: PresentationParameters.RenderTargetUsage is stored, cloned and exposed but never consulted by GraphicsDevice
issues.summary: Only a render target's own usage is read (in SetRenderTargets); the back buffer's RenderTargetUsage has no effect when SetRenderTargets returns to the back buffer.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::PresentationParameters::RenderTargetUsage

issues.title: Only BasicEffect exposes XNA's parameter graph and technique name; the other stock effects still lack texture or light parameters and carry a Default technique
issues.summary: AlphaTestEffect lacks Texture, DualTextureEffect lacks Texture/Texture2, EnvironmentMapEffect lacks DirLight*, SkinnedEffect lacks Texture/DirLight*; these effects carry a Default technique and WorldInverseTranspose keeps a 4x4 shape.
issues.public_contract: Effect::getParametersProperty() and CurrentTechnique of AlphaTestEffect, DualTextureEffect, EnvironmentMapEffect, SkinnedEffect

issues.title: Several live GraphicsDevices share process-wide window and input slots with last-writer semantics
issues.summary: The window-to-renderer registry is a static, unsynchronised map with no ownership check, and TextInputEXT and Mouse keep one process-wide window slot, so two devices overwrite each other's registry entries and input target.
issues.public_contract: IGraphicsRenderer::RegisterForWindow/UnregisterForWindow/GetForWindow; TextInputEXT and Mouse window binding with more than one GraphicsDevice

issues.title: EasyGL does not register Texture3D with its context-loss recovery, so volume texture contents are lost after a real WebGL/GLES context loss
issues.summary: EasyGLTexture3DRenderer is not a RecoverableResource, unlike EasyGL's 2D textures, cube textures, render targets, buffers and queries.
issues.public_contract: Texture3D on EasyGL profiles with context loss (WebGL2, GLES)

issues.title: SDL_GPU accepts ShaderEffect GLSL only in Vulkan-rule form (#version 450, explicit locations and SDL_gpu sets), so the shared GLSL ES 3.00 .cnj effect fixture does not load there
issues.summary: SdlGpuEffectRenderer::CompileProgram passes GLSL to libshaderc for SPIR-V, which rejects GLSL ES 3.00 sources and implicit uniform bindings; CNA's portable .cnj effect fixture is written in GLSL ES 3.00.
issues.public_contract: ShaderEffect construction from GLSL source and ContentManager::Load of GLSL .cnj effects on SDL_GPU

issues.title: DIRECTX9 ignores the MSAA request for RenderTargetCube
issues.summary: CreateRenderTargetCube discards multiSampleCount, so cube render targets are never multisampled on DIRECTX9; the cube target reports MultiSampleCount 0, so nothing is misreported.
issues.public_contract: RenderTargetCube(multiSampleCount > 0) on DIRECTX9

issues.title: PbrEffect takes one punctual light per draw
issues.summary: PbrEffect and SkinnedPbrEffect carry a single PunctualLightEXT, so a scene with several point or spot lights must split draws per light; the double-sided back-face flip that this entry also listed now runs on every PBR renderer.
issues.public_contract: PbrEffect::setPunctualLightEXT (one PunctualLightEXT per effect)

issues.title: The XNB DateTime reader discards the two DateTimeKind bits, so Utc and Local values load as plain tick counts
issues.summary: DateTimeReader masks off the two kind bits and returns System::DateTime(ticks) with an unspecified kind, and it does not convert a Local-kind value to local time as XNA does. The header justifies the deviation by System::DateTime not modelling a kind, but System::DateTime has a (ticks, DateTimeKind) constructor at TARGET, so that reason is stale.
issues.public_contract: XNB DateTime values read through ContentReader (DateTimeReader)

issues.title: Models built to .xnb carry no cameras, because an XNA Model has no camera storage
issues.summary: A glTF compiled to .xnb drops its cameras with a build warning, so the model loads with an empty CamerasEXT; the direct glTF, .cnj and .cnb routes carry them, and Model.hpp still documents the property as empty for every other content path.
issues.public_contract: Model::getCamerasEXTProperty() on models loaded through .xnb, .cnj and .cnb; the XNB model output of the content build

issues.title: Runtime glTF import has no unit-scale option; only the offline converters can rescale a model
issues.summary: ContentManager's glTF reader always imports at unitScale 1.0, so a file not authored in metres must go through the offline converters: cna_tool_gltf_to_cnb --unit-scale, or the optional unitScale argument of cna_tool_gltf_to_cnj.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on .gltf/.glb

issues.title: EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing is not imported: each node keeps one placement and its per-instance transforms are dropped
issues.summary: A node declaring EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing is imported with its own single transform, so the file renders one copy where it describes many; the drop is reported per file (gpu-instancing-dropped).
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on glTF files using EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing

issues.title: Mirrored glTF placements keep the shared winding, so under the default cull mode they render back-facing
issues.summary: A placement whose world transform has a negative determinant is detected and reported (mirrored-winding-unapplied) but CNA neither reverses its winding nor changes cull state, and exposes no per-mesh flag for the application to do it.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on glTF files with negatively scaled or mirroring node transforms; Model::Draw

issues.title: The glTF vertex ABI carries two UV channels, one joint-influence set and one colour set; further sets are dropped and reported
issues.summary: TEXCOORD sets beyond the first two sampled ones, JOINTS_1/WEIGHTS_1 and later, and COLOR_1 and later are not imported; each loss is named in the import report.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> and the offline converters on glTF primitives with extra attribute sets

issues.title: A skinned glTF model cannot also carry rigid scene-node animation: tracks not driven by its skins are dropped
issues.summary: Model::Tag holds SkinningData for a skinned model, so scene-node clips whose tracks are not carried by a skin palette are dropped with the rigid-animation-dropped-on-skinned-model diagnostic.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on glTF files that animate non-joint nodes of a skinned model

issues.title: A glTF mesh placed by several nodes takes its morph-weight animation from the first of them only
issues.summary: ExtractMorphWeightTrack resolves a mesh to the first node in file order that instances it, so every placement plays that node's weights channel and channels on the other nodes are ignored.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on glTF files that animate morph weights of a multiply-instanced mesh

issues.title: CUBICSPLINE bone and node channels are replayed linearly between samples taken at least every 1/60 s, an approximation of the authored curve
issues.summary: BuildTrack samples each CUBICSPLINE interval at least every 1/60 s and AnimationPlayer lerps/slerps between the samples, so the curve between samples is approximated.
issues.public_contract: AnimationPlayer and SkinnedModelEXT playback of glTF clips with CUBICSPLINE interpolation

issues.title: glTF skins with more than 72 joints are refused at import
issues.summary: BuildSkeleton throws for a skin above the 72-matrix GPU palette (SkinnedEffect::MaxBones), naming the joint count, instead of truncating it.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> and the offline converters on glTF skins with more than 72 joints

issues.title: glTF punctual lights are approximated as at most three directional lights; point and spot lights have no native support
issues.summary: KHR_lights_punctual is imported into XNA's three-directional-light model: point and spot lights become directional lights aimed at the origin, ranges and cones are ignored, and lights beyond three are dropped and counted.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on glTF files using KHR_lights_punctual; the imported lights applied to BasicEffect/PbrEffect

issues.title: XACT features FAudio never finished are unimplemented: QUEUE and REPLACE_QUIETEST limits, band-pass track filters, reverb sends and DSP-preset RPCs
issues.summary: CNA reproduces FAudio's shipped behaviour: QUEUE and REPLACE_QUIETEST evict the oldest cue, a cue-level limit picks its victim from the whole bank, band-pass filters cannot be decoded, and reverb and DSP-preset RPC targets do nothing.
issues.public_contract: AudioEngine category and cue instance limits; XACT sound-bank track filters; Cue RPC evaluation; SoundEffectInstance reverb

issues.title: CNA has no sound-instance limit: InstancePlayLimitException is declared but never thrown
issues.summary: XNA throws InstancePlayLimitException when too many sound instances play and SoundEffect.Play returns false for it; CNA declares the type but no code path raises it.
issues.public_contract: SoundEffectInstance::Play(), SoundEffect::Play() and InstancePlayLimitException

issues.title: XACT wave-bank entries compressed as XMA/XMA2 or WMA produce no sound
issues.summary: WaveBank::GetSoundEffect returns null for XMA and WMA entries after logging a warning through CNA's logger, so cues using them are silent.
issues.public_contract: WaveBank loading and playback of XMA/XMA2 and WMA (xWMA) wave entries

issues.title: StorageDevice::DeviceChanged is declared but never raised
issues.summary: The static event exists for API compatibility, but nothing in the snapshot raises it; genuine XNA 4.0 raises it through FrameworkCallbackLinker.StorageDeviceChanged when a storage device changes, and CNA's desktop storage root has no such change source.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Storage::StorageDevice::DeviceChanged

issues.title: QualityOfService of PlayerMatch and Ranked search results is never measured
issues.summary: QualityOfService of a PlayerMatch or Ranked search result is never measured: IsAvailable stays false and the round-trip and bandwidth fields stay 0, so online lobbies cannot sort sessions by connection quality.
issues.public_contract: AvailableNetworkSession::getQualityOfServiceProperty() for PlayerMatch/Ranked listings; QualityOfService

issues.title: The terminal window title is stored but never emitted, so SetTitle has no visible effect
issues.summary: TerminalWindow::SetTitle records the title and defers the OSC emission to the session, but the session prologue emits no title sequence and nothing else writes one, so a terminal window title is never shown.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Platform::IPlatformWindow::SetTitle(const std::string&) on the terminal platform

issues.title: TerminalSession does not restore or re-establish the terminal on job-control stop and continue (SIGTSTP/SIGCONT)
issues.summary: The session's restoring signal set covers termination and crash signals but not SIGTSTP/SIGCONT, so a Ctrl-Z that suspends a terminal game leaves the terminal in raw mode, the alternate screen and mouse reporting until the process is resumed.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Platform::Terminal::TerminalSession terminal restoration on job-control signals

issues.title: CNA::Devices host dialogs are minimal: message boxes are unparented, tray icons have no image API, and UrlLauncher passes any string to the OS
issues.summary: MessageBox passes a null parent window, SystemTray offers only a tooltip and menu, and UrlLauncher::Open forwards its argument unvalidated to the platform (SDL_OpenURL on the SDL3 platform).
issues.public_contract: CNA::Devices::MessageBox::Show, CNA::Devices::SystemTray, CNA::Devices::UrlLauncher::Open

issues.title: In a MinGW-w64 cross tree CnaTests gets a Wine CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR only when the default renderer is DIRECTX9
issues.summary: For any other default renderer (for example SDL_GPU, the toolchain file's own usage example) gtest discovery (DISCOVERY_MODE PRE_TEST) and ctest try to execute the Windows CnaTests binary directly on the Linux host.
issues.public_contract: cmake/UnitTests.cmake CnaTests CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR chain; cross-compiled CTest runs

issues.title: No renderer or subsystem registers an IDiagnosticsSource, and nothing registers ResourceKind::AudioVoice resources
issues.summary: The diagnostics source seam for GPU timings and renderer statistics has no production implementation and no engine code registers audio-voice resource metadata, so those diagnostics and Inspector views stay empty at this snapshot.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Diagnostics::IDiagnosticsSource / RegisterSource and CNA::Diagnostics::ResourceKind::AudioVoice

issues.title: No renderer implements IResourcePreviewProvider, and the seam cannot cancel a preview ticket the agent abandons
issues.summary: Resource previews are unavailable in every real Inspector session because no CNA renderer installs a preview provider, and when a client disconnects the agent drops its pending tickets without telling the provider.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Inspector::IResourcePreviewProvider (RequestPreview, PollPreview) and AgentConfiguration::previewProvider

issues.title: The C ABI has no route for 633 public C++ declarations that the coverage inventory records as planned
issues.summary: COVERAGE.md records 633 in-scope public C++ declarations without a C mapping (graphics 252, content 203, graphics-ext 36 and smaller tails in nine other modules), which is why the C ABI release gate reads Not ready.
issues.public_contract: CNA C ABI 0.50.0 (modules/c-api/include/CNA/C) against the public C++ surface of the modules it links

issues.title: A fixed-step TargetElapsedTime above 500 ms never produces an Update from Game::Tick, essentially the same ceiling XNA 4.0 has
issues.summary: With IsFixedTimeStep true, Game::Tick clamps the accumulator to MaxElapsedTime (500 ms) before its update loop, so a TargetElapsedTime above 500 ms is never reached: Update does not run while Draw keeps running, at about 1 / (target - 500 ms) per second (twice a second for a one-second target). XNA 4.0's Tick has essentially the same ceiling (about 508 ms, because of its 1/64 snap), but neither updates nor draws above it, so the limit is inherited; the setter accepts such a value silently.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Game::setTargetElapsedTimeProperty(const System::TimeSpan&) with IsFixedTimeStep true; Game::Tick()

issues.title: WEBGPU does not propagate a real device loss: OnDeviceLost only logs, so DeviceLost, the device status and the draw gate react only to the debug hooks
issues.summary: WebGPURenderer sets its lost flag, closes CanBeginDrawEXT() and raises DeviceLost only inside DebugSimulateContextLoss; the callback registered for a real loss only writes to stderr. CNA's own plan (WEBGPU-182) records the driver-reported path as not done and unverified, so this is an incomplete feature rather than a broken contract.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice::DeviceLost / DeviceReset, getGraphicsDeviceStatusProperty() and the CanBeginDrawEXT() gate behind GraphicsDeviceManager::BeginDraw, on the WEBGPU renderer

issues.title: The renderer capability profile has no feature for pre-compiled SPIR-V payloads, so SDL_GPU reports every source-dialect feature Unsupported
issues.summary: BuildRendererCapabilityProfileEXT maps a renderer's declared dialect onto six source-dialect features. SDL_GPU declares SpirV, which CNA documents as compiled bytecode rather than source, so all six read Unsupported and no profile entry says a SPIR-V payload is accepted.
issues.public_contract: CNA::RendererCapabilityProfile ShaderDialect* features (GraphicsDevice::GetRendererCapabilityProfileEXT)

issues.title: A runtime .cnj Texture2D colorKey leaves keyed texels as straight-alpha (key RGB, alpha 0), so they are invisible only under a non-premultiplied blend state
issues.summary: The loose-tier .cnj Texture2D reader writes Color(keyR, keyG, keyB, 0) into a straight-alpha texture, deliberately: plans/plan_cnj.md CNB-9 defines the result as transparent with alpha 0, and CnjSourceFileTests pins it. Under SpriteBatch's default premultiplied AlphaBlend such a texel adds the key colour instead of vanishing; the compiled route premultiplies after keying and clears it.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Texture2D>(name) for a .cnj Texture2D document with colorKey; SpriteBatch::Begin() default BlendState::AlphaBlend

issues.title: ScrollWheelValue drops sub-notch wheel motion: the SDL3 platform counts whole notches only, where XNA accumulates raw wheel units
issues.summary: The SDL3 platform truncates every wheel event to whole notches before scaling by 120 (a deliberate FNA-parity rule in docs/input-fna-fidelity.md), so high-resolution wheels and touchpads can scroll without changing ScrollWheelValue; XNA accumulates 1/120 units.
issues.public_contract: MouseState::getScrollWheelValueProperty() and getHorizontalScrollWheelValueEXTProperty() as reported by Mouse::GetState()

issues.title: Video playback is unavailable on Windows, MinGW, Emscripten, Android and iOS: CNA has no FFmpeg integration for those targets yet
issues.summary: modules/CMakeLists.txt marks those targets as outside the FFmpeg integration, so CNA_ENABLE_VIDEO=AUTO falls back to the no-video backend and ON fails configuration; Video probing and VideoPlayer::Play then throw NotSupportedException. docs/video-backend.md describes this as 'no target-native FFmpeg integration or decode verification yet' (MEDIA-192 to MEDIA-195), so it is unfinished CNA work rather than a constraint of those platforms.
issues.public_contract: Video, VideoPlayer and Load<Video> on Windows (MSVC and MinGW), Emscripten, Android and iOS builds

issues.title: NetworkSession's Local, LocalWithLeaderboards and SystemLink Begin/End pairs are synchronous: Begin runs the callback and returns a completed result, and End does the work on the caller's thread
issues.summary: For Local, LocalWithLeaderboards and SystemLink sessions, BeginCreate, BeginFind and BeginJoin run the callback inline and return a completed result; End* then blocks: 150 ms for a SystemLink Find, up to 5 s for a SystemLink Join.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Net::NetworkSession::BeginCreate/BeginFind/BeginJoin and the matching End* methods for Local, LocalWithLeaderboards and SystemLink sessions

issues.title: Only EasyGL leases its context to other threads: on every other renderer, graphics resources created on a loading thread have no CNA-level exclusion against the frame
issues.summary: GraphicsDevice's resource registry is now locked and EasyGL leases its context to resource creation on any thread, but every other renderer returns no lease and has no synchronization of its own, while XNA 4.0 creates its device D3DCREATE_MULTITHREADED.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::GraphicsDevice and GraphicsResource: creating or disposing resources from a thread other than the game thread

issues.title: Guests cannot take part in PlayerMatch or Ranked sessions
issues.summary: Guests of a signed-in account can play in Local, LocalWithLeaderboards and SystemLink sessions, but PlayerMatch and Ranked refuse them (GamerServicesNotAvailableException, or GamerPrivilegeException from AddLocalGamer): a guest has no service identity.
issues.public_contract: NetworkSession Create, Find and Join (and their Begin/End forms) and AddLocalGamer for PlayerMatch and Ranked sessions whose local gamers include a guest SignedInGamer

issues.title: Compiled XNA effects whose pixel shaders use BEM, TEXDEPTH, TEXDP3, TEXDP3TEX, TEXM3X2DEPTH or TEXREG2AR/GB/RGB cannot run on SDL_GPU, WEBGPU or FNA3D's SDL_GPU driver
issues.summary: MojoShader's SPIR-V profile, which CNA's SDL_GPU and WEBGPU compiled effects and FNA3D's SDL_GPU driver use, refuses these eight shader model 1.x instructions by name ('... unimplemented in spirv profile'); its GLSL profile translates them, so the same effects run on EasyGL and on FNA3D's OpenGL driver.
issues.public_contract: Compiled XNA 4.0 effects (Effect from .xnb or .fxb) whose pixel shaders use the shader model 1.x instructions BEM, TEXDEPTH, TEXDP3, TEXDP3TEX, TEXM3X2DEPTH, TEXREG2AR, TEXREG2GB or TEXREG2RGB, on the SDL_GPU and WEBGPU compiled-effect routes and on the FNA3D renderer's SDL_GPU driver

issues.title: WEBGPU and DIRECTX9 refuse a RenderTargetCube face in a multiple-render-target set, although both report MultipleRenderTargets
issues.summary: SetRenderTargets with a cube face among two or more bindings throws NotSupportedException on WEBGPU and DIRECTX9, while XNA's HiDef profile accepts it and SDL_GPU binds it since 51fb39d5a; a single cube face and sets of 2D targets work.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice::SetRenderTargets with a RenderTargetBinding for a RenderTargetCube face among several bindings (HiDef), on WEBGPU and DIRECTX9

issues.title: SDL_GPU honours BlendState.MultiSampleMask only as all-or-none and refuses a partial mask, and FNA3D's SDL_GPU driver ignores it, because SDL_gpu reserves its sample-mask fields
issues.summary: SDL 3.5.0 still documents SDL_GPUMultisampleState::sample_mask/enable_mask as reserved, so on a multisampled target SDL_GPU draws normally for a mask keeping every sample, drops the draw for a mask keeping none and throws NotSupportedException for any other; FNA3D's SDL_GPU driver writes the reserved field without effect. RendererFeature::MultiSampleMask reports both.
issues.public_contract: BlendState.MultiSampleMask / GraphicsDevice.MultiSampleMask on SDL_GPU and on the FNA3D renderer's SDL_GPU driver

issues.title: EasyGL on GLES/WebGL contexts without GL_NV_polygon_mode or WEBGL_polygon_mode refuses most wireframe triangle draws
issues.summary: Without a polygon-mode extension EasyGL draws only two bounded stock routes as line loops (non-indexed PositionColor and indexed PositionNormal TriangleLists); every other FillMode::WireFrame triangle draw throws NotSupportedException.
issues.public_contract: RasterizerState.FillMode = WireFrame on the GLES and WebGL EasyGL profiles

issues.title: On OpenGL ES 3.0 and WebGL 2 contexts OcclusionQuery::PixelCount is boolean (0 or 1)
issues.summary: ES 3.0 and WebGL 2 only offer GL_ANY_SAMPLES_PASSED, so EasyGL reports whether any sample passed rather than how many; the public OcclusionQuery::isPixelCountPreciseEXT() reports which kind of count is in effect, but only after the first query has begun.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::OcclusionQuery::PixelCount on EasyGL GLES/WebGL profiles

issues.title: SDL_GPU cannot create OcclusionQuery objects because SDL_gpu 3.5.0 has no occlusion-query commands
issues.summary: SdlGpuRenderer::CreateOcclusionQuery throws NotSupportedException: SDL_gpu exposes no query pools, and its fences report only command-buffer completion.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::OcclusionQuery on SDL_GPU

issues.title: Android Compass and Motion: stopping waits at most five seconds for the sensor worker, after which the bridge is abandoned for good and a handler still running can outlive its owner
issues.summary: AndroidSensorBridge::Stop gives a wedged worker five seconds and then detaches it, marking the bridge permanently unable to start; a Compass or Motion destroyed after such a timeout, while a callback is still inside it, is an unsupported window.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Devices::Sensors::Compass and Motion on Android (AndroidCompassBackend and AndroidMotionBackend over Detail::AndroidSensorBridge): Start(), Stop(), Dispose() and destruction

issues.title: Threaded Emscripten builds on the default WasmFS have no persistent storage, so StorageDevice refuses rather than saving
issues.summary: Threaded Emscripten builds default to WasmFS, which cannot link IDBFS, so StorageDevice there reports StorageDeviceNotConnectedException instead of persisting saves unless the application configures CNA_EMSCRIPTEN_USE_WASMFS=OFF.
issues.public_contract: StorageDevice/StorageContainer and LocalGamerServicesStore in threaded Emscripten builds

issues.title: Under Emscripten, SystemLink discovery is empty, hosting binds the fixed port 61191 and Join returns before the handshake
issues.summary: The web build stubs out discovery (Find returns nothing), hosts on a fixed port only a Node.js relay can use, rebuilds a joining session as an outbound-only client and returns from Join before the server welcome; Node.js-run unit tests cover discovery and loopback handshakes, but no browser or two-process test exists.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Net::NetworkSession Create, Find, Join and Update for NetworkSessionType::SystemLink in Emscripten builds

issues.title: Wayland gives no desktop pointer position, and browsers hide gamepads until a button press and gate pointer lock on a user gesture
issues.summary: Under SDL3's Wayland video driver the desktop pointer position reads (0, 0) and the cursor cannot be warped reliably; on the web a gamepad appears only after the player presses a button on it, and relative mouse mode engages only after a click.
issues.public_contract: Mouse::GetGlobalPositionEXT / WarpGlobalEXT on a Wayland session (SDL3's wayland video driver); GamePad connection and Mouse relative mode in Emscripten builds

issues.title: Compass and Motion work only on Android; desktop sensors come only through the SDL3 platform, and web targets are refused
issues.summary: Compass::IsSupported and Motion::IsSupported are false everywhere except Android, as SDL3 exposes no magnetometer or fused-orientation API; Accelerometer and Gyroscope read real sensors on Android, iOS and desktop, never in a browser.
issues.public_contract: Compass, Motion, Accelerometer and Gyroscope IsSupported per target

issues.title: On Apple, SamplerState.MipMapLevelOfDetailBias does not reach the GPU on FNA3D's non-OpenGL drivers
issues.summary: FNA3D on macOS and iOS hands a sampler LOD bias to SDL's Metal-backed GPU driver, which ignores it, so the bias is accepted without effect; RendererFeature::SamplerLevelOfDetailBias reports that.
issues.public_contract: SamplerState.MipMapLevelOfDetailBias on the FNA3D renderer on macOS and iOS; GraphicsDevice::SupportsRendererFeatureEXT(RendererFeature::SamplerLevelOfDetailBias)

issues.title: FNA3D has no occlusion queries on its SDL_GPU driver, the driver FNA3D tries first and the one it runs on Apple
issues.summary: Fna3dRenderer probes queries only on FNA3D's OpenGL and Direct3D 11 drivers; on its SDL_GPU driver (FNA3D's first choice, and its Metal route on Apple) OcclusionQuery is reported unsupported and its constructor refuses, because SDL3's GPU API has no queries.
issues.public_contract: OcclusionQuery and GraphicsCapability::OcclusionQuery on the FNA3D renderer

issues.title: Online PlayerMatch and Ranked session traffic needs a libcurl with WebSocket support; with macOS's system libcurl the relay refuses with RELAY_SECURE_WEBSOCKET_UNAVAILABLE
issues.summary: PlayerMatch and Ranked sessions carry their traffic over a WSS relay through libcurl's WebSocket API, so a libcurl without ws/wss and TLS (Apple's system libcurl 8.7.1, or one older than 7.86) refuses the relay and those sessions cannot run.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Net::NetworkSession Create, Join and JoinInvited for NetworkSessionType::PlayerMatch and Ranked with a configured CNA gamer-services endpoint; the realtime relay at /cna/relay/v1 and the push channel /cna/v1/events

issues.title: FNA3D refuses a PbrEffect or SkinnedPbrEffect draw whose vertex declaration has no Tangent0 on its SDL_GPU and Direct3D 11 drivers, where every other renderer draws it with a neutral tangent
issues.summary: FNA3D's SDL_GPU and Direct3D 11 drivers cannot build a pipeline for a shader input the declaration lacks, so the FNA3D renderer throws NotSupportedException (FNA3D-MISSING-STOCK-INPUT) for a PBR draw over tangent-free vertices such as VertexPositionNormalTexture; its OpenGL driver and the other renderers supply a neutral tangent.
issues.public_contract: PbrEffect and SkinnedPbrEffect (CNAEXT) draws on the FNA3D renderer with a VertexDeclaration that has no Tangent element at usage index 0, when FNA3D runs its SDL_GPU or Direct3D 11 driver

issues.title: Matrix camera builders have no XNA oracle and no full-matrix value test
issues.summary: CreateLookAt and the perspective and orthographic builders are asserted only on single terms and covered indirectly by consumer tests; CNA's XNA matrix oracle does not include them.
issues.public_contract: Matrix::CreateLookAt, CreatePerspective, CreatePerspectiveFieldOfView, CreatePerspectiveOffCenter, CreateOrthographic and CreateOrthographicOffCenter

issues.title: BoundingSphere::CreateFromBoundingBox and the SmoothStep/Hermite/CatmullRom helpers use different arithmetic from XNA 4.0, and no oracle measures last-bit agreement
issues.summary: CreateFromBoundingBox and the SmoothStep/Hermite/CatmullRom helpers compute with formulas or precision that differ from XNA's, and only CreateFromPoints has an XNA oracle.
issues.public_contract: BoundingSphere::CreateFromBoundingBox; MathHelper::SmoothStep, Hermite, CatmullRom; Vector2/3/4::SmoothStep and Hermite

issues.title: No test pins EffectParameter's divergences for CNA-constructed parameters, including a SetValue(Texture*) that GetValueTexture2D() does not read back
issues.summary: Parameters without compiled storage keep separate base and typed texture slots and refuse numeric access only for Object-class parameters; the C API smoke test exercises the lenient string, numeric and texture setters, but no test pins that a texture set through the base overload reads back as null, or that the numeric refusal is by class rather than by storage.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::EffectParameter SetValue/GetValue on stock-effect and standalone parameters

issues.title: The XNA audio facade on CNA's own ALSA mixer is covered by seven facade tests plus the XACT category suite; the SoundEffect, instance, dynamic-instance, Cue, SoundBank and WaveBank suites run only on SDL3
issues.summary: Under CNA_AUDIO_PLATFORM=ALSA, eight SDL3_mixer-bound suites (about 440 test definitions) are filtered out, so SoundEffect, SoundEffectInstance and DynamicSoundEffectInstance behaviour on CNA's mixer rests on seven facade cases, and Cue, SoundBank and WaveBank playback on the twelve AudioCategoryTests cases that play cues from real banks.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Audio (SoundEffect, SoundEffectInstance, DynamicSoundEffectInstance, AudioEngine, Cue, SoundBank, WaveBank) under CNA_AUDIO_PLATFORM=ALSA

issues.title: Media paths without tests: the natural song end on SDL3_mixer, the failed visualization install and SavePicture's IOException
issues.summary: The song-ended callback path on the default SDL3 audio, the visualization branch where no tap can be installed and SavePicture's write-failure exception are implemented but untested.
issues.public_contract: MediaPlayer::Update end-of-song handling, MediaPlayer::setIsVisualizationEnabledProperty and MediaLibrary::SavePicture

issues.title: The SDL3 camera provider and file-dialog result path have no test that drives them, and the tray is tested only against a stand-in SDL
issues.summary: Sdl3Camera.cpp and the SDL3 dialog trampoline are exercised by no test beyond capability presence and empty-callback refusal; Sdl3Tray.cpp is now linked against a stand-in SDL seam, but no test creates a real tray icon.
issues.public_contract: The SDL3 camera provider and sessions, tray icons and file dialogs (Sdl3CameraProvider, Sdl3Tray, Sdl3Dialogs) behind CNA::Devices::Camera, SystemTray and FileDialog

issues.title: Android and iOS have no device evidence at this snapshot: no Android workflow, iOS only in the Simulator, and lifecycle and packaged-content loading untested on a device
issues.summary: Android has no preset or workflow; iOS evidence is device final-links plus a one-frame Simulator smoke on SOFTWARE, the SDL_GPU iOS legs are non-gating and never recorded as built, no physical device has run CNA, and no test loads packaged content on one.
issues.public_contract: Android and iOS as CNA targets (Game lifecycle, ContentManager with a relative root, TitleLocation)

issues.title: No test exercises PlatformSelection.cmake's reserved-identifier refusal paths
issues.summary: PlatformSelection.cmake fails configure for SDL12, EMSCRIPTEN and TERMINAL on Windows, but no test asserts those refusals; the one platform-selection test, CnaPlatformSelection_Retired, covers only the retired and unknown names.
issues.public_contract: cmake/PlatformSelection.cmake configure-time refusals for reserved CNA_PLATFORM values

issues.title: No gate checks include reachability or compiles each public C++ header alone
issues.summary: No CMake test or workflow checks that a module's includes stay inside its declared module graph or compiles each framework public C++ header in isolation; the two unwired campaign scripts written for this were removed with their archive.
issues.public_contract: The physical module include contract (docs/physical-modules.md) and the self-containment of the public C++ headers

issues.title: The physical source-partition validator checks only *.cpp/*.mm path prefixes, so headers, C sources and a TU in a renderer's src/ subdirectory (never compiled) all pass it
issues.summary: modules/CMakeLists.txt's no-loss ownership gate globs only .cpp and .mm and compares path prefixes, while cna_add_renderer globs src/*.cpp non-recursively, so a new TU under src/<subdir>/ passes configure and is silently not built.
issues.public_contract: modules/CMakeLists.txt physical source-partition validator; modules/renderers/CMakeLists.txt cna_add_renderer

issues.title: CNA records and checks no easy-gl or meta-gl revision, although the snapshot needs meta-gl 20c8b2dc or later and easy-gl deda7a42 or later
issues.summary: EasyGLRenderer.cpp needs meta-gl's InternalFormat::Rgba16 (from 20c8b2dc) and RendererSelection.cmake relies on easy-gl's exception-model variable (from deda7a42), yet nothing pins or checks either sibling revision.
issues.public_contract: GL-family builds (OPENGLES3, OPENGL33, WEBGL2) consuming ../easy-gl and ../meta-gl

issues.title: A plain ctest run of the tests preset is not a trustworthy result
issues.summary: The tests preset builds only CnaTests, yet ctest also runs the display-dependent smoke executables the same configuration registers and reports the unbuilt ones as failed, so CNA's own preset calls a direct CnaTests run the only authoritative result.
issues.public_contract: ctest over a build of the tests preset (CMakePresets.json)

issues.title: The HEADLESS native-SDK-free link-closure gates run in no CI job
issues.summary: The link-closure check reads a Ninja tree's link line, so general-tests-ci.yml evaluates its OPENGLES3 tree's gates; the NativeSdkFree_* and GraphicsNativeSdkFree gates exist only in single-renderer HEADLESS trees, which no CI job tests through ctest.
issues.public_contract: The ModuleLinkClosure_NativeSdkFree_* and ModuleLinkClosure_GraphicsNativeSdkFree CTests registered by cmake/Tests/ModuleProbes.cmake

issues.title: The hand-written CnaPlatformTests filter misses TerminalPresenterThroughPlatformTest and nine other platform suites, so the platform CI cells never select them
issues.summary: CnaPlatformTests selects suites by hand-written name tokens: TerminalPresenter.* misses TerminalPresenterThroughPlatformTest, and nine more platform suites (key codes, scancodes, filesystem, sensor session, SDL3 device services, input devices, system back, exit under lock) match no platform filter. Only four of their cases are selected, by the input filter's case-name tokens.
issues.public_contract: cmake/UnitTests.cmake CnaPlatformTests filter coverage of the platform suites (the terminal presenter through-the-platform case and nine others)

issues.title: No SpriteFont/DrawString pixel test exists for DIRECTX9 or FNA3D
issues.summary: SpriteFont/DrawString reach pixels in registered tests on EasyGL, SOFTWARE, SDL_GPU and WEBGPU (the shared sprite_font parity fixture, the SpriteFont cross-family program and the EasyGL SpriteFont oracles); DIRECTX9 and FNA3D have none.
issues.public_contract: SpriteBatch::DrawString / SpriteFont rendering per renderer

issues.title: No test measures presentation cadence: PresentInterval::Two against ordinary vsync
issues.summary: The registered interval tests on EasyGL, SOFTWARE, SDL_GPU and WEBGPU and the shared forwarding contract check storage, forwarding and the selected present mode, not the resulting frame timing.
issues.public_contract: PresentationParameters.PresentationInterval (One, Two, Immediate) and the renderers' swap-interval / present-mode mapping

issues.title: No browser renderer path is executed automatically: WEBGL2 has no test registrations and no workflow runs a renderer in a browser
issues.summary: WEBGL2 has no test registrations, and CI only links a WEBGL2+WEBGPU bundle without running it; no workflow runs any renderer in a browser.
issues.public_contract: WEBGL2 and WEBGPU renderer identities in Emscripten builds

issues.title: WEBGPU and SDL_GPU run in CI only through subsystem suites and a macOS smoke set; their renderer suites run only on CNA's own runner
issues.summary: CI now selects both identities, but only for the glTF-conformance, input and platform suites (on lavapipe) and, for SDL_GPU, a focused macOS smoke set; the renderers' own SdlGpu_* and WebGPU_* suites run only in CNA's recorded local runs.
issues.public_contract: WEBGPU and SDL_GPU renderer identities and their example test suites

issues.title: The Windows renderer routes have no automatic native Windows execution: the DIRECTX9 and SDL_GPU legs of the Windows workflow are manual
issues.summary: The native Windows workflow (DIRECTX9 and an SDL_GPU Direct3D 12 smoke leg) runs only on manual dispatch, as does the SDL3-on-Windows platform job; CNA records no native run of either leg, and its Windows rendering evidence is Wine.
issues.public_contract: DIRECTX9 and SDL_GPU renderer routes on native Windows (SDL_GPU through SDL's Direct3D 12 driver)

issues.title: Several XNB runtime readers are never exercised with externally produced files, although genuine XNA 4.0 outputs for some of them are already in the tree
issues.summary: Texture3D, Curve, Video, DXT1/DXT5 Texture2D, container-version-4 textures and four of the five stock effects are read in tests only from CNA-written or hand-built bytes; the XNA-built differential corpus is used only by pipeline tests.
issues.public_contract: The XNB type readers for Texture3D, Curve, Video, Texture2D (DXT1/DXT5, version 4) and AlphaTestEffect, DualTextureEffect, EnvironmentMapEffect and SkinnedEffect

issues.title: No fuzz target covers .cnj documents or the JSON parser, and .cnj files are read whole with no size bound
issues.summary: The content fuzz suites cover the XNB container, LZX, XNB writer input and the CNB container; ContentManager's ReadTextFile reads any .cnj into memory before parsing, with no counterpart of XnbReadLimits.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager's .cnj tier (ReadTextFile, ParseCnjEnvelope and the per-type .cnj readers)

issues.title: Model drawing on SOFTWARE, SDL_GPU, WEBGPU, FNA3D and DIRECTX9 is checked in CI at most at the stride draw boundary; the shared Model programs and the whole-corpus L7 rung run in CI for OPENGLES3 only
issues.summary: The EasyGL Model draw, hierarchy, two-mesh, skinned-playback and .cnj reader programs run verbatim as CTests on SOFTWARE and SDL_GPU, but no workflow runs them; the SOFTWARE whole-corpus L7 campaign is a committed report from an earlier commit.
issues.public_contract: ModelMesh::Draw / Model::Draw on each 3D renderer; the glTF L7 image comparison

issues.title: The real-world Khronos comparison matrix passes on one surviving renderer; GLTF ROBUST row 12 needs four
issues.summary: Gate C's retake matrix (Fox, DamagedHelmet, Sponza and the sparse cases against the Khronos sample renderer) is recorded passing on OPENGLES3; the two other renderers it passed on were retired, and the row needs four including a Direct3D path.
issues.public_contract: glTF import and rendering compared with the Khronos glTF-Sample-Renderer on real assets

issues.title: Input behaviour on real hardware is unverified: the 15-task manual hardware checklist is blocked, and the focus-loss keyboard test checks only the bridge's accumulator
issues.summary: Controllers, touch, IME, non-US layouts, joysticks and host sensors are recorded as unverified on hardware, and the focus-loss keyboard test reads InputManager's legacy state through a local shim, not the public Keyboard::GetState.
issues.public_contract: Keyboard::GetState across focus loss; GamePad, TouchPanel, text input/IME and device input on real hardware

issues.title: The three user-reported audio release blockers (high pitch, missing files, distortion) have never been compared against the original game
issues.summary: plans/plan_audio.md keeps its three user-reported release blockers unchecked; one hypothesis class was ruled out offline, but no capture of the affected game under XNA and CNA exists.
issues.public_contract: Audio playback rate, pitch and loading fidelity for real XNA games

issues.title: CNA's audio plan carries two undiagnosed test-suite crashes (AUD-15-021, AUD-15-022) that have not been re-run at this snapshot
issues.summary: An intermittent segfault in AudioMixerSpecOverrideTest within the full audio filter and a heap-corruption abort at teardown after CueTest.*:DynamicSoundEffectInstanceTest.* are recorded as open, blocked on gdb/valgrind.
issues.public_contract: The audio test suites (CueTest, DynamicSoundEffectInstanceTest, AudioMixerSpecOverrideTest) and the code they exercise

issues.title: DynamicSoundEffectInstance's PendingBufferCount accounting is untested when the stream resamples
issues.summary: PendingBufferCount compares submitted chunk sizes with the stream's queued-byte count; every test uses a 44,100 Hz source matching the mixer, so the accounting under rate or format conversion is unestablished.
issues.public_contract: DynamicSoundEffectInstance::getPendingBufferCountProperty() and the BufferNeeded event

issues.title: Android sensor conventions are unverified on hardware, and the default landscape remap is a reflection, not a rotation
issues.summary: No hardware QA record exists for Microsoft::Devices; CNA's own MOT2-001 analysis found the default-on landscape remap negates one axis (determinant -1), and the Android compass/motion sign conventions and demo copy are unverified or stale.
issues.public_contract: Accelerometer, Gyroscope, Compass and Motion readings on Android; SetAndroidLandscapeRemapEnabled

issues.title: CNA::Devices extension tests use canned platforms or check only that the host call does not fail, and exist only in a CNA_DEVICES=ON build
issues.summary: Camera, FileDialog, MessageBox and SystemTray tests drive canned platform services; the Clipboard, DisplayInfo, Locale, PowerInfo, SystemInfo and UrlLauncher tests call the host but mostly assert only that nothing crashes; every body is wrapped in #ifdef CNA_DEVICES (default OFF), so only the devices workflow's ON build runs them.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Devices (Camera, Clipboard, DisplayInfo, FileDialog, Locale, MessageBox, PowerInfo, SystemInfo, SystemTray, UrlLauncher)

issues.title: The process-spawning networking tests are compiled out on Windows, Emscripten, Android and iOS, and multi-machine behaviour has no test evidence
issues.summary: TwoProcessLoopbackTest.cpp and GamerServicesDispatcherHangRegressionTest.cpp are filtered out for WIN32, EMSCRIPTEN, ANDROID and iOS; several-machine behaviour, Windows shared-port binding and browser sessions have no test evidence, and host migration is tested only on POSIX hosts.
issues.public_contract: NetworkSession over ENet (SystemLink) on every target

issues.title: The CNA_STRICT_XNA_API purity check calls only the Microsoft::Devices sensor surface and one SamplerStateCollection indexer
issues.summary: cna_strict_xna_api_check calls only Devices/Sensors members and one SamplerStateCollection indexer, and its must-fail twin includes only Accelerometer.hpp, so no automated check covers strict-mode purity or marker completeness of the other XNA surfaces.
issues.public_contract: CNA_STRICT_XNA_API and the CNAEXT marker (StrictXnaApiSurfaceCheck_Compile_Run, StrictXnaApiSurfaceLeakCheck_MustFailToCompile)

issues.title: CnaTests' Wine test route does not prove which Direct3D implementation served a run
issues.summary: CnaTests' Wine emulator skips the DXVK engagement gate for discovery and for every discovered case, including GoogleTest cases that create a device, so a passing cross-built run does not show which Direct3D implementation rendered it.
issues.public_contract: CnaTests CTest routes for DIRECTX9 in MinGW cross trees

issues.title: No automatic workflow runs the XNA reference-image corpus comparisons other than the EasyGL line pair, or the FNA value-differential harness
issues.summary: D3D9_XNA_Diff, Fna3d_XNA_Oracle and Software_XnaLineCoverage are in no workflow's test selection, and the FNA value-differential harness is manual because it needs mono and a built FNA.dll.
issues.public_contract: The XNA reference-image corpus CTests and the FNA value-differential harness (tools/fna-reference, cna_reference_dump, scripts/compare-fna-reference.py)

issues.title: Test strength is never measured automatically: no coverage build, no scheduled fuzzing campaign and no mutation testing
issues.summary: No workflow or CMake option enables coverage instrumentation, the libFuzzer-capable harnesses are not CTests and no job or schedule runs them (their recorded campaigns were manual, one-time runs), and no source-mutation checker exists.
issues.public_contract: CNA's test-strength instruments: coverage, fuzzing, mutation checking

issues.title: The XNA API census (331/331 types, 3,627/3,627 members) measures representation only and is a manually run script
issues.summary: Every member row of docs/xna-4-runtime-member-coverage.json records behavior_assessed false, and tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py is run by no workflow or CTest, so behavioural evidence exists only for the subsets named by individual tests and oracles.
issues.public_contract: docs/xna-4-runtime-member-coverage.json and tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py

issues.title: No CI configuration builds diagnostics at STATS or FULL or enables CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR, so most Diagnostics tests and every Inspector test are never compiled in CI
issues.summary: CNA_DIAGNOSTICS and CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR default to OFF and no workflow or preset changes either, so 38 of 40 DiagnosticsTests, the seven audio and graphics diagnostics tests and all 27 Inspector tests run only in local builds.
issues.public_contract: The STATS/FULL diagnostics implementation (CNA_DIAGNOSTICS) and the optional Inspector (CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR) with their test suites

issues.title: The Inspector's WebBridge security checks and Agent::Stop paths have no automated test
issues.summary: No test drives the HTTP bridge (Host check, UI-token gate, 32-connection cap, request parsing, response headers), and no test calls Agent::Stop directly, stops an agent with a client attached, or starts an agent again after stopping one.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Inspector::Detail::WebBridge (the cna-inspector browser bridge) and CNA::Inspector::Agent::Stop

issues.title: No CI workflow builds the C API library or runs its tests
issues.summary: No workflow at this snapshot configures CNA_BUILD_C_API=ON; the C API workflows only run generators, inventories, a release gate and a header compile matrix, so the library and its tests are verified only in local builds.
issues.public_contract: The C API library (CNA_BUILD_C_API) and its test suites under modules/c-api/tests

issues.title: Destroying a caller-created GraphicsDevice while resources on it are still live is allowed by cna_graphics_device_destroy but untested
issues.summary: graphics_device.h says resources on a caller-created device are released with it and the destroy route checks no child count, but every C test destroys the resources first, so what later calls on those resource handles do rests on reading.
issues.public_contract: cna_graphics_device_create / cna_graphics_device_destroy (CNA/C/graphics_device.h) and the resource handles created on a caller-created device

issues.title: The checked-in shader bytecode headers of SDL_GPU and DIRECTX9 come from generators that no CTest or workflow runs and that have no --check mode
issues.summary: spirv_shaders.hpp (SDL_GPU) and the d3d9_*shaders.hpp headers (DIRECTX9) come from hand-run generators with no --check mode and no CTest or workflow, so a shader source edit without regeneration would go unnoticed.
issues.public_contract: The checked-in generated shader headers of the classic renderers (spirv_shaders.hpp for SDL_GPU, the d3d9_*shaders.hpp headers for DIRECTX9)

issues.title: EasyGL Task 933 (a full-backbuffer SpriteBatch draw breaking that frame's 3D rendering) rests on one recorded sample run: no test reproduces the reported scene, and the migration guide still lists it as open
issues.summary: CNA's graphics plan closed Task 933 on its 2026-08-23 run of the original sample (SAMPLE-005) after two synthetic investigations never reproduced the symptom; the plan is deleted, no checked-in test covers that scene, and docs/migration-guide.md and a test comment still call the finding open.
issues.public_contract: docs/migration-guide.md's open EasyGL caveat (Task 933): a full-backbuffer SpriteBatch draw before the first 3D draw of a frame

issues.title: The VibrateController shutdown-ordering tests never open a haptic device or destroy a Game-owned SDL3 platform after SDL_Quit, and CNA's own plan keeps SDLCORE-011 open for that reason
issues.summary: The ordering test spawns a harness that probes the controller and calls SDL_Quit, but no haptic device is opened and the platform is the immortal lazy default, so the SDL_CloseHaptic-after-SDL_Quit path stays reasoned from source only.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Devices::VibrateController shutdown ordering (DevicesShutdownCoordinator, Sdl3Haptics::CloseAll) relative to SDL_Quit

issues.title: HeadlessPlatform::InjectEvent, the display-free event seam, has no caller and no test
issues.summary: HeadlessPlatform::InjectEvent is documented as the way to test input, runtime and lifecycle behaviour with no display, yet nothing calls it and no test covers inject-then-PollEvents delivery; the only refill test drives a test-local FakePlatform.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Platform HeadlessPlatform::InjectEvent (the display-free event-injection seam, plans/plan_platform.md PLAT-115)

issues.title: SDL_GPU is the default renderer on Windows, macOS and iOS but is not qualified there
issues.summary: Since the native Windows and Apple renderers were retired, a build for Windows, macOS or iOS defaults to SDL_GPU, yet CNA records no native Windows run of it, no Apple run since the retirement and no iOS build.
issues.public_contract: The per-host default renderer (CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER left unset) on Windows, macOS and iOS: SDL_GPU, through SDL's Direct3D 12 and Metal drivers
